The low point seems to last longer for women—throughout their 30s and 40s, only climbing __15__ women reach 50. Men, on the other hand, have the lowest point in their 40s, going up again when they reach 50.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】once 在你腦中大概只有兩個身分：副詞「曾經」（I once lived in Japan.）與「一次」（once a week）。它還有第三個身分——從屬連接詞「一旦…就」，後面接完整子句——只記得前兩個身分的話，句子需要連接詞時就不容易想到它。【怎麼判斷】先看空格後面：women reach 50 是主詞加動詞的完整子句，需要有東西把它接上主要子句，所以這一格要填連接詞。這一步就把 once 的「曾經」與「一次」排除了——那兩個身分是副詞，帶不了子句。確定要連接詞之後再看語意方向：主要子句說女性的低潮橫跨三十幾與四十幾歲，only climbing 表示要到某個時間點才開始回升，所以連接詞要表達「這個條件成立，結果才發生」。once 當連接詞正是這個意思：Once you understand the rule, the rest is easy.（一旦懂了規則，其餘就簡單了。）驗算在下一句。作者接著寫男性：Men, on the other hand, have the lowest point in their 40s, going up again when they reach 50.——同一個「到五十歲才回升」的意思，寫男性時用 when，寫女性時用 once。前後對照，方向就確定了。順帶把 once 與 as soon as 分清楚，兩者常被當成同義詞。as soon as 重的是時間緊接：As soon as we hear any news, we'll call you.（一有消息就通知你。）once 重的是條件成立：My boss is a nice man once you get to know him.（一旦你了解他，我老闆人很好。）後面這句換成 as soon as 就不通，因為「了解一個人」不是瞬間發生的事，是一道門檻。【誘答選項】三個都是連接詞，句法上都塞得進去，要靠語意刷掉。unless 是「除非」，等於 if...not，放進來會變成「只在女性還沒滿五十歲時才回升」，與「到五十歲才回升」正好相反。before 是「在…之前」，時間順序顛倒——低潮是持續「到」五十歲，不是五十歲「之前」就結束。since 當連接詞有「自從」與「因為」兩義：「自從女性年滿五十」通常要配完成式，本句沒有；「因為女性年滿五十」把時間點說成原因，與 only climbing 的語氣對不上。【常考字詞與句型】once + S + V（一旦…就，重條件）、as soon as（一…就，重時間）、the moment (that)（一…就）、by the time …（到…的時候）、once in a while（偶爾）、at once（立刻）。
discriminationNote: 鑑別度 7，高低分群的差距不大。本題答對率一成二，屬於難度很高的題目——大考中心《選才電子報》第 307 期說明鑑別度時，就把答對率低的難題列為鑑別度偏低的原因之一：高、低分群考生在這類題目上的答對率差距不大，鑑別度的數值就會比較小。這一題比較像是不分程度的考生都在同一個字上轉向：once 最先想到的是「一次、曾經」這個副詞用法，而這一格用的是連接詞的 once，等於 as soon as 或 after。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：once 當連接詞，「一旦…就」
readMore.hint: 重點：once 當從屬連接詞時等於 as soon as 或 after，引導時間子句，講的是「一旦…就」；本句是女性的低潮要到五十歲才開始回升，unless（除非）是條件而且方向相反，before（在…之前）把先後顛倒過來，since（自從、因為）也對不上。

sentence: Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them.
explanation: 【句型】certain as to + 問題，as to 表示「關於」，not certain as to exactly what...是固定用法，表示「對於……究竟是什麼並不確定」。due to（由於）、instead of（而不是）、in spite of（儘管）都不符合這裡的搭配。
fullPassage: The northern lights, known as the aurora borealis, is one of nature's most dazzling spectacles. Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them. Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__, they flash here and there like giant searchlights. Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds. According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth. It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是幾個字合起來當一個介系詞用的組合，你會憑哪個中文順挑一個，其中 due to 最眼熟，很容易先被選走。【怎麼判斷】答對率四成。先看空格後面接的是什麼：exactly what these lights are and what causes them——兩個 what 引導的名詞子句。所以空格要的是一個能帶出「關於什麼」的說法。四個選項裡只有 as to 是「關於、至於」，而且它後面正好可以接疑問詞引導的名詞子句（as to what、as to whether）。前面的 not certain 與它成組：be certain 或 uncertain as to + 疑問詞子句，就是「對……確定或不確定」。填進去讀成 Science is still not certain as to exactly what these lights are（科學界對這些光究竟是什麼仍不確定）。【誘答選項】due to（由於）帶出的是原因；instead of（而不是）帶出的是被取代的那樣東西；in spite of（儘管）要求前後語意相反。三個的語意都不是「關於」，放進來說不通。【常考字詞與句型】as to + 疑問詞子句（關於、至於）、be uncertain as to whether（不確定是否）、due to（由於）、instead of（而不是）、a dazzling spectacle（令人目眩的奇景）、the northern lights（北極光）。

sentence: Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__ , they flash here and there like giant searchlights.
explanation: At other times 意為「在其他時候」，與前一句句首的 Sometimes 呼應：極光有時像扇形向上散開，有時則像巨大探照燈四處閃爍；At one time（曾經）、At all times（隨時）、At the same time（同時）都無法構成這組呼應。
fullPassage: The northern lights, known as the aurora borealis, is one of nature's most dazzling spectacles. Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them. Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__, they flash here and there like giant searchlights. Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds. According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth. It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
contextNote: 前一句以 Sometimes 起頭，本句 At other times 與之呼應
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都以 At 開頭，字面都跟時間有關，只能靠與前一句的呼應關係判斷。【怎麼判斷】線索是前一句的 Sometimes：Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan.（有時候，明亮的光束呈扇形向上散開）——句首用了 Sometimes，本句自然要用 At other times（在其他時候）來承接。Sometimes… At other times… 是英文描述兩種交替出現的情況常用的一組說法，同義的還有 Sometimes… Other times…、At times… At other times…。這一格必須讀前一句才選得出來。【誘答選項】At one time：「曾經、一度」，指過去某段時期（At one time, old houses like this were cheap.），但本句用現在式，描述極光現在反覆出現的樣子。At all times：「隨時、無時無刻」，但前一句才說「有時候」呈扇形，本句若說「隨時」四處閃爍，前後矛盾。At the same time：「同時」，極光不會同時呈扇形向上散開又像探照燈四處閃爍，前後矛盾。【常考字詞與句型】Sometimes… At other times…（有時…有時…）、at one time（曾經、一度）、at all times（隨時）、at the same time（同時）、at times（有時）。

sentence: Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds.
explanation: to and fro 意為「來回地、前後擺盪」，形容極光如布幔般在天空搖曳；here and now（此時此地）、by and large（大體而言）、more and more（越來越）語意都不合。
fullPassage: The northern lights, known as the aurora borealis, is one of nature's most dazzling spectacles. Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them. Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__, they flash here and there like giant searchlights. Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds. According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth. It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是「A and B」形式的固定片語，字面拆開都看得懂，合起來卻各有各的意思——這類片語只能整組記。to and fro ＝ 來回地（fro 原本就是 from 的意思，現在幾乎只出現在這個片語裡）：The swing moved gently to and fro.（鞦韆輕輕地來回擺盪）。【怎麼判斷】線索是同句的動詞與對照：空格前的動詞是 sway（搖曳），後半句又說 flames… play up and down the moving folds（火焰在飄動的褶皺間上下跳躍）——up and down 與 to and fro 一個上下、一個來回，在同一句裡前後呼應，看到後半句的 up and down，前半就該想到同類型的方向片語。同類片語一次記齊：to and fro（來回）、up and down（上下）、back and forth（來回，同 to and fro）、here and there（到處）、by and large（大體而言）、here and now（此時此地）。【誘答選項】here and now：「此時此地、就在現在」（We're going to solve this problem right here and now.），說的是時間與地點，不是擺動的方式；本句用現在式描述極光平常的樣子，不是在講某一刻發生的事，與後半句的 up and down 也配不成對。by and large：「大體而言」，用來總結或概括一個看法，放在描寫動作的句子裡說不通。more and more：「越來越」，說的是程度隨時間增加（It gets more and more difficult …）；本句描述的是極光一向的樣子，不是在講擺動越來越劇烈，而且後半句的 up and down 是方向片語，前半要的也是同類的方向說法。【常考字詞與句型】sway to and fro（來回擺盪）、back and forth（來回）、up and down（上下）、here and there（到處）、by and large（大體而言）。

sentence: According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth.
explanation: 描述科學事實／現象的恆常狀態，用簡單現在式 takes place。was taking place（過去進行式）、had taken place（過去完成式）、took place（簡單過去式）都是描述過去特定事件，不符合這裡陳述科學事實的語境。
fullPassage: The northern lights, known as the aurora borealis, is one of nature's most dazzling spectacles. Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them. Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__, they flash here and there like giant searchlights. Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds. According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth. It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項是同一個片語的四種時態，你會去找句子裡有沒有時間副詞，找不到就憑語感挑一個。【怎麼判斷】答對率四成三，鑑別度高達 54。先確認這一句在做什麼事：According to scientific measurements（根據科學測量），後面講的是北極光發生在離地五十到一百英里的高度——這是一個一直都成立的事實，不是某一次發生過的事件。陳述科學事實、自然現象與恆常狀態，用簡單現在式，所以填 takes place。填進去讀成 this discharge of light takes place from 50 to 100 miles above the earth。整篇的動詞形態也能拿來驗算：前後的 is、spread、looks、hang、sway 全是現在式，這一格和它們對齊就好。【誘答選項】took place 是簡單過去式、was taking place 是過去進行式、had taken place 是過去完成式，三個都把這件事鎖在過去某個時間點上，與「科學測量得出的恆常事實」對不上，而且句子裡沒有任何過去的時間標記可以搭。【常考字詞與句型】take place（發生、舉行）、according to（根據）、scientific measurements（科學測量）、discharge（放電、排放）、above the earth（在地球上方）、from A to B（從 A 到 B 的範圍）。

sentence: It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
explanation: at its best 意為「處於最佳、最壯觀的狀態」：極光在加拿大哈德遜灣一帶、蘇格蘭北部與挪威、瑞典南部看得最為壯觀；in the least（一點也不）用於否定句，on the whole（整體而言）、for its sake（為了它）都不合。
fullPassage: The northern lights, known as the aurora borealis, is one of nature's most dazzling spectacles. Science is still not certain __16__ exactly what these lights are and what causes them. Sometimes, the brilliant rays of light spread upward in the shape of a fan. __17__, they flash here and there like giant searchlights. Farther north, the aurora frequently looks like fiery draperies which hang from the sky and sway __18__ while flames of red, orange, green, and blue play up and down the moving folds. According to scientific measurements, this discharge of light __19__ from 50 to 100 miles above the earth. It is seen __20__ around the Hudson Bay region in Canada, in northern Scotland, and in southern Norway and Sweden.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】at its best 這個片語你可能比較少見到，四個選項擺在一起時，最眼熟的往往不是答案。【怎麼判斷】先看句子缺什麼。It is seen ___ around the Hudson Bay region... 主詞 It、動詞 is seen 都已經齊全，空格填的是修飾動詞的副詞片語，四個選項都是介系詞片語，句法一樣過關，要靠語意與搭配決定。先用一個句法線索刷掉一個：in the least（一點也不）是強調用語，只用在否定句與疑問句，標準說法是 not in the least；本句是肯定的直述句，它進不來。剩下的靠語意。at its best 是「處於最佳狀態、最出色的時候」，其中的所有格會隨主詞改變：at his best、at her best、at their best。本句主詞 It 回指前面談的極光，所以用 its——「極光最壯觀的時候是在這幾個地方看到的」。驗算法：把 its 換成它回指的名詞唸一遍——the aurora is seen at the aurora's best around the Hudson Bay region，所有格對得上主詞，方向就對了。前一句是科學測量的客觀敘述（這種光出現在地表上方五十到一百英里處），本句接著點出在哪些地區看得最壯觀，語氣是正面的，與 at its best 相合。順帶把最容易混淆的一組連著記：at its best 與 at best 只差一個 its，意思幾乎相反。at its best ＝ 處於最佳狀態（正面）；at best ＝ 充其量、頂多（帶保留或負面語氣）：The film was at best mediocre.（這部片頂多算普通。）再加上 at worst（往壞處說），三個一起記最不會亂。【誘答選項】in the least 如前所述受句型限制，肯定句用不上。on the whole 是「整體而言」，用來總結全面情況，但本句正好相反，講的是特定幾個地區看得最好，不是整體概況。for its sake 是「為了它」，for the sake of 表示目的或利益，而「被看見」這件事沒有一個為誰而做的目的，語意接不上。【常考字詞與句型】at its／his best（處於最佳狀態）、at best（充其量）、at worst（往壞處說）、not in the least（一點也不）、on the whole（整體而言）、for the sake of（為了…的緣故）。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：at its best，最好看的那個時候
readMore.hint: 重點：at + 所有格 + best 是「處於最佳狀態」，所有格隨主詞變（at its best、at his best）；與 at best（充其量）意思不同。

sentence: This may not sound like much, but it could change the Earth's climate as __22__ before.
explanation: as never before 意為「以前所未有的方式」：升溫幅度聽起來不大，卻可能以前所未有的程度改變地球氣候；ever、always、yet 都無法與 as…before 構成這個說法。
fullPassage: Average global temperature has increased by almost 1°F over the past century. Scientists expect it to increase an __21__ 2° to 6°F over the next one hundred years. This may not sound like much, but it could change the Earth's climate as __22__ before. Climate change may affect people's health both directly and indirectly. For instance, heat stress and other heat-related health problems are caused directly by very warm temperatures. __23__, human health can also be affected by ecological disturbances, changes in food and water supplies, as well as coastal flooding. How people and nature __24__ climate change will determine how seriously it affects human health. Generally, poor people and poor countries are __25__ probable to have the money and resources they need to cope with health problems due to climate change.
discriminationNote: 鑑別度 10，高低分群的差距不大。本題答對率三成九——大考中心《選才電子報》第 307 期說明鑑別度時提到，鑑別度低表示高、低分群考生的答對率差距小，原因很多，而且它與答對率一樣，只是推論試題品質的指標之一。這一題的難處在於 as never before 是固定說法，意思是「前所未有地」：ever before 眼熟，容易順手填 ever，但 as ever 與 as always 都是「一如往常」，與 This may not sound like much, but… 這個先退後進的轉折相反；後半句要把程度拉高，只有 never 做得到。
note: 【你可能會這樣想】as ___ before 這個結構看起來像少了什麼，你可能想填 ever，因為 ever before 眼熟。但 ever 通常跟在比較級或否定詞之後（better than ever before、hardly ever）；as ever 雖然也是個說法，意思卻是「一如往常」。as never before 才是固定說法，意思是「以前所未有的方式、程度前所未見」：The country is changing as never before.（這個國家正以前所未有的方式改變。）【怎麼判斷】先看句子的語氣走向。本句用 This may not sound like much, but… 起頭（這聽起來似乎不多，但是…），這是一個先退後進的句式：前半先承認讀者的第一印象，後半要把它推翻。既然是推翻，後半必須把嚴重性拉高，而且拉得越高，這個轉折才站得住。四個選項裡只有 never 能把程度推到頂——「以前從來沒有過的程度」。前一句提到科學家預估未來一百年的升溫幅度是華氏二到六度，數字本身確實不起眼，正是這個句式要處理的第一印象。驗算法：把 as never before 換成中文的「前所未有地」唸一遍——它可能以前所未有的程度改變地球氣候，語氣與 but 的轉折對得上。看到 may not sound…, but… 這個形狀，就知道作者要推翻你的第一印象，答案一定落在「把程度拉高」那一側。【誘答選項】ever 放進來是 as ever，如前所述意思是「一如往常」，與 as always 相同，會把事情說成常態，與 but 的轉折相反。always 是「總是」，as always 確實是個說法，但意思是「一如往常」，放進來會變成「像往常一樣改變氣候」，語氣不但沒拉高，反而把事情說成常態，與 but 的轉折相反。yet 當副詞用於否定句與疑問句（not yet 尚未），也常見於 the best yet（目前為止最好的），但沒有 as yet before 這種說法，形式上就不成立。【常考字詞與句型】as never before（以前所未有地）、better than ever before（比以往更好）、hardly ever（幾乎從不）、as always（一如往常）、not yet（尚未）、This may not sound like much, but…（這聽起來似乎不多，但…）。

sentence: Climate change may affect people's health both directly and indirectly. For instance, heat stress and other heat-related health problems are caused directly by very warm temperatures. __23__ , human health can also be affected by ecological disturbances, changes in food and water supplies, as well as coastal flooding.
explanation: Indirectly 意為「間接地」，與前一句的 directly 形成對照：高溫直接造成熱壓力等問題，人體健康也會間接受到生態擾動、糧食與水源變化的影響；Suddenly、Previously、Exclusively 都無法構成這組對照。
fullPassage: Average global temperature has increased by almost 1°F over the past century. Scientists expect it to increase an __21__ 2° to 6°F over the next one hundred years. This may not sound like much, but it could change the Earth's climate as __22__ before. Climate change may affect people's health both directly and indirectly. For instance, heat stress and other heat-related health problems are caused directly by very warm temperatures. __23__, human health can also be affected by ecological disturbances, changes in food and water supplies, as well as coastal flooding. How people and nature __24__ climate change will determine how seriously it affects human health. Generally, poor people and poor countries are __25__ probable to have the money and resources they need to cope with health problems due to climate change.
contextNote: 前一句 caused directly by very warm temperatures，本句 Indirectly 與之對照
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是 -ly 副詞，放在句首都像在承接上文，單看本句 human health can also be affected by … 似乎哪一個都讀得通。關鍵在前一句：這一格要的是與前一句 directly 相對的那個字。【怎麼判斷】線索是前一句的 directly：For instance, heat stress and other heat-related health problems are caused directly by very warm temperatures.（舉例來說，熱壓力等問題是高溫「直接」造成的）——既然前一句用了 directly，本句自然要用 Indirectly 來接另一半。而且本句句中還有 also（也會受影響），再次確認這是在補上另一種途徑。看到前一句有 directly、physically、economically 這類說明途徑或層面的副詞，下一句常常就是它的對照組。更上一層還有依據：再往前一句是 Climate change may affect people's health both directly and indirectly.（氣候變遷可能直接與間接地影響人體健康）——作者先總說 directly and indirectly，再分別展開。本句正是「間接」那一半，結構完全對稱。【誘答選項】Suddenly：「突然」，講的是速度與時間，與前一句的 directly 構不成對照，生態擾動、糧食與水源的變化也不是突然發生的事。Previously：「先前」，指時間順序，但本句說的是另一種影響途徑，不是更早發生的事。Exclusively：「只、專門」，若說人體健康「只」受生態擾動等因素影響，就與前一句「高溫直接造成」的說法相衝。【常考字詞與句型】directly／indirectly（直接地／間接地）、both A and B（既 A 又 B）、be affected by（受…影響）、ecological disturbances（生態擾動）。

sentence: Generally, poor people and poor countries are __25__ probable to have the money and resources they need to cope with health problems due to climate change.
explanation: less probable（較不可能）符合「貧窮的人和國家較不可能擁有足夠的金錢和資源」的語意，呼應貧窮與資源匱乏的邏輯關係。very、most（most 前面沒有 the 時是正式語體的「非常」，very probable 與 most probable 都是「很可能」，方向相反）、further（更進一步）都不符合。
fullPassage: Average global temperature has increased by almost 1°F over the past century. Scientists expect it to increase an __21__ 2° to 6°F over the next one hundred years. This may not sound like much, but it could change the Earth's climate as __22__ before. Climate change may affect people's health both directly and indirectly. For instance, heat stress and other heat-related health problems are caused directly by very warm temperatures. __23__, human health can also be affected by ecological disturbances, changes in food and water supplies, as well as coastal flooding. How people and nature __24__ climate change will determine how seriously it affects human health. Generally, poor people and poor countries are __25__ probable to have the money and resources they need to cope with health problems due to climate change.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項擺進去好像都通，尤其 very probable 完全合文法，你可能就直接選它。【怎麼判斷】答對率四成七，鑑別度高達 57。這一格 very 也放得進去、文法上挑不出錯，所以形態刷不掉，真正要判的是方向。主詞是 poor people and poor countries（貧窮的人與貧窮的國家），後面接的是 to have the money and resources they need（擁有他們所需的金錢與資源）。貧窮的人與國家當然比較不可能有錢與資源，所以要的是往下的方向——less probable。填進去讀成 poor people and poor countries are less probable to have the money and resources they need。【誘答選項】very probable（很可能）方向剛好相反；most 前面沒有 the，在這裡不是最高級，而是正式語體的「非常」，most probable（非常可能）和 very 一樣方向相反；further（更進一步的）修飾的是距離或程度上的推進，不能拿來修飾 probable。【常考字詞與句型】less + 形容詞（較不……）、be likely to V（可能會）、be unlikely to V（不太可能會）、probable（可能的）、the money and resources（金錢與資源）、generally（一般來說）。

sentence: The entire country is mountainous, __26__ a small strip of subtropical plains in the extreme south.
explanation: with the exception of 意為「除…之外」，與 except for 同義：不丹全境都是山地，只有最南端一小條亞熱帶平原例外；in terms of（就…而言）、as a part of（作為…的一部分）、in accordance with（依照）語意都不合。
fullPassage: The Kingdom of Bhutan is a landlocked nation situated between India and China. The entire country is mountainous, __26__ a small strip of subtropical plains in the extreme south. The elevation gain from the subtropical plains to the glacier-covered Himalayan heights exceeds 7,000 m. Its traditional __27__ is based on forestry, animal husbandry and subsistence agriculture. However, these __28__ less than 50% of the GDP now that Bhutan has become an exporter of hydroelectricity. Besides, cash crops and tourism are also __29__. Bhutan is one of the most isolated nations in the world, __30__ foreign influences and tourism regulated by the government to preserve its traditional Tibetan Buddhist culture. It is often described as the last surviving refuge of traditional Himalayan Buddhist culture.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】exception 你認得名詞「例外」，卻不見得知道 with the exception of 是幾個字合起來當一個介系詞用，功能等同 except for。四個選項都是這種「多字介系詞」，長得像，差別全在它們表達的邏輯關係。【怎麼判斷】先確認空格的身分。逗號後面接的是名詞片語 a small strip of subtropical plains，不是完整子句，所以要填介系詞，四個選項句法上都過關，要靠邏輯關係決定。接著看主要子句在講什麼：The entire country is mountainous（全境都是山地）——The entire 宣告的是一個「全部」的敘述。一個句子既然說了「全部」，後面補的那一段自然是把例外扣掉。看到 entire、all、every、no one 這類涵蓋全體的字，就往「排除」的方向找。驗算法：把句子拆成兩句唸一遍——The entire country is mountainous. The small strip of plains in the south is the only exception.（全境都是山地，南端那一小條平原是唯一的例外。）拆得開，就是排除關係。同樣的邏輯 94 年第 25 題也考過一次，那一年給的是 except for，配的線索字是 virtually all；這一年換成 with the exception of，線索字換成 The entire。判斷方式一模一樣：先找宣告全體的那個字。【誘答選項】三個都是多字介系詞，錯在邏輯關係不同。in terms of 是「就…而言」，用來限定討論的角度（in terms of cost 就成本而言），本句不是在切換角度。as a part of 是「作為…的一部分」，會讀成「平原是山地的一部分」，但平原與山地正是相對的兩種地形，自相矛盾。in accordance with 是「依照」，後面接的是規定、法律或標準，一片平原不是可以依照的東西。【常考字詞與句型】with the exception of（除…之外）、except for（除…之外）、without exception（無一例外）、make an exception（破例）、in terms of（就…而言）、in accordance with（依照）。
discriminationNote: 鑑別度 18，高低分群的差距不算大。本題答對率二成三，屬於難度偏高的題目——大考中心《選才電子報》第 307 期說明鑑別度時，就把答對率低的難題列為鑑別度偏低的原因之一：高、低分群考生在這類題目上的答對率差距不大，鑑別度的數值就會比較小。這一題比較像是不分程度的考生都停在同一處：四個選項都是多字介系詞，長得像，差別全在邏輯關係；with the exception of 要先認得它等於 except for，再看主要子句裡 The entire 宣告的「全部」，後面那一段才讀得出是把例外扣掉。

readMore.hint: 重點：with the exception of 等於 except for，用來把例外從整體裡扣掉；同一組一起記：without exception（無一例外）、make an exception（破例）。

sentence: Bhutan is one of the most isolated nations in the world, __30__ foreign influences and  tourism regulated by the government to preserve its traditional Tibetan Buddhist culture.
explanation: 【句型】with + 受詞 + 受詞補語（表附帶狀態），with foreign influences and tourism regulated 表示「外國影響力與觀光業受到政府管制」這個附帶狀態。by／for／in 都沒有這種用法。
fullPassage: The Kingdom of Bhutan is a landlocked nation situated between India and China. The entire country is mountainous, __26__ a small strip of subtropical plains in the extreme south. The elevation gain from the subtropical plains to the glacier-covered Himalayan heights exceeds 7,000 m. Its traditional __27__ is based on forestry, animal husbandry and subsistence agriculture. However, these __28__ less than 50% of the GDP now that Bhutan has become an exporter of hydroelectricity. Besides, cash crops and tourism are also __29__. Bhutan is one of the most isolated nations in the world, __30__ foreign influences and tourism regulated by the government to preserve its traditional Tibetan Buddhist culture. It is often described as the last surviving refuge of traditional Himalayan Buddhist culture.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】with 這個字，你的印象大概只有「和……一起」與「用……」，看到它後面接著一長串 foreign influences and tourism regulated by the government，會覺得沒有一個介系詞放得進去。【怎麼判斷】答對率不到五成，鑑別度只有 28，連高分群考生也會失手，原因在於這個句型擺在句子最後面、後面又接一長串修飾語，形狀不容易認出來。先把空格後面拆成兩層：foreign influences and tourism 是受詞，regulated by the government 是補充說明這個受詞處於什麼狀態，還原成完整子句就是 foreign influences and tourism are regulated by the government（外國影響力與觀光業受到政府管制）。能還原成「受詞是或處於那個狀態」，就確定是 with + 受詞 + 受詞補語（表附帶狀態）這個句型，空格填 with。同一年第 11 題也考 with，但那一題考的是 be satisfied with 這個固定的字詞搭配，兩題擺在一起，正好看出同一個介系詞的兩種考法。【誘答選項】by、for、in 都不能帶出「受詞 + 受詞補語」這兩層來表示附帶狀態；把它們填進去，regulated by the government 那一串就沒有地方可以掛。【常考字詞與句型】with + 受詞 + 受詞補語（表附帶狀態）、with his eyes closed（閉著眼睛）、with the engine running（引擎還發動著）、be regulated by（受……管制）、preserve a culture（保存文化）、isolated（孤立的、與外界隔絕的）。

sentence: __13__ they are still called “phones”—a word meaning “voice” in Greek—making voice calls may no longer be their primary function.
explanation: Even if（即使）引導讓步子句，表示「即使手機仍被稱作『phone』（希臘文原意是聲音），但打電話可能已不再是主要功能」，符合「即使∼但∼」的讓步邏輯；As long as（只要）為條件關係，語意不合；Just as（正如）、Only when（只有當）都不符合此處的讓步轉折。
fullPassage: The telephone is widely considered as the most rapidly evolving technological device today. Many experts in the field believe that future phones will not only look very different—they may not even be __11__. They may be hidden in jewelry or accessories, or even embedded in the body. They will undoubtedly have a lot of additional features and __12__ functions, and users may interact with them in new ways, too. __13__ they are still called “phones”—a word meaning “voice” in Greek—making voice calls may no longer be their primary function. With advances in contemporary design and technology, the phones may __14__ remote controls, house keys, Game Boys, maps, flashlights, health monitors, recorders, handguns, and so on. __15__, they will be “the remote-control for life.”
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是從屬連接詞、後面都接子句，形態上刷不掉，你會一個一個代進去讀。【怎麼判斷】這是邏輯勾環：要判斷的是兩個子句之間的邏輯關係。先把兩邊講的事讀清楚：空格後的子句是 they are still called “phones”（它們仍然被叫做「電話」，而 phone 這個字在希臘文裡就是「聲音」）；主要子句是 making voice calls may no longer be their primary function（打語音電話可能不再是它們的主要功能）。名字還叫電話，功能卻不再以講電話為主——兩邊語意相反，這就是讓步關係，用 Even if（即使、縱使）。填進去讀成 Even if they are still called “phones,” making voice calls may no longer be their primary function。【誘答選項】As long as（只要）是條件，會讀成「只要還叫電話，打電話就不再是主要功能」，前後成了因果，說不通；Just as（正如、就像）要求前後是相似的類比，但這裡兩邊相反；Only when（只有當……時）也是條件，而且放句首時主要子句一定要倒裝，本句沒有倒裝，形態上就先排除——先看主要子句有沒有倒裝，比慢慢想語意快得多。【常考字詞與句型】even if（即使、縱使）、even though（雖然，用於既成事實）、as long as（只要）、just as（正如、就像）、only when + 主要子句倒裝（只有當……時）、primary function（主要功能）。

sentence: With advances in contemporary design and technology, the phones may __14__ remote controls, house keys, Game Boys, maps, flashlights, health monitors, recorders, handguns, and so on. __15__ , they will be “the remote-control for life.”
explanation: 【句型】serve as + 角色/功能，表示「充當、扮演……的角色」，符合未來手機可以「充當」遙控器、鑰匙等多種裝置的語意。call for（需要）、get over（克服）、relate to（與……有關）都不符合這種「身兼多種功能」的語意。
fullPassage: The telephone is widely considered as the most rapidly evolving technological device today. Many experts in the field believe that future phones will not only look very different—they may not even be __11__. They may be hidden in jewelry or accessories, or even embedded in the body. They will undoubtedly have a lot of additional features and __12__ functions, and users may interact with them in new ways, too. __13__ they are still called “phones”—a word meaning “voice” in Greek—making voice calls may no longer be their primary function. With advances in contemporary design and technology, the phones may __14__ remote controls, house keys, Game Boys, maps, flashlights, health monitors, recorders, handguns, and so on. __15__, they will be “the remote-control for life.”
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是兩個字組成的片語動詞，你會憑哪個中文順就選了它。【怎麼判斷】鑑別度高達 63。先看空格後面接的是什麼：一長串東西——遙控器、家門鑰匙、掌上遊戲機、地圖、手電筒——全都是別的裝置。所以這一句在說「一支手機同時兼任這些東西的角色」，四個選項裡只有 serve as 是「充當、兼作」，後面接的正是它扮演的那個角色。填進去讀成 the phones may serve as remote controls, house keys, Game Boys, maps...（手機可以兼作遙控器、家門鑰匙、掌上遊戲機、地圖……）。serve 的兩種常見用法可以擺在一起記：serve as + 角色是「充當」，serve + 人或食物是「服務、供餐」。【誘答選項】call for（需要、要求）後面接的是所需要的東西，手機不是「需要」那些裝置；get over（克服、痊癒）後面接的是困難或疾病；relate to（與……有關）鬆散地讀起來也通、形態也吻合，容易被順手選走，但它只說得出「有關聯」，講不出「取代並兼任」這一層，與下一句「人生的萬能遙控器」那個口氣對不上。【常考字詞與句型】serve as（充當、兼作）、act as（扮演……的角色）、call for（需要、要求）、get over（克服、痊癒）、relate to（與……有關）、house keys（家門鑰匙）。

sentence: The fruits and vegetables we eat often come in distinctive colors. The rich colors, __16__ , are not there only to attract attention.

fullPassage: The fruits and vegetables we eat often come in distinctive colors. The rich colors, __16__, are not there only to attract attention. They perform another important function for the plants. Research shows that the substances __17__ these colors actually protect plants from chemical damage. The colors come mainly from chemicals known as antioxidants. Plants make antioxidants to protect themselves from the sun's ultraviolet (UV) light, __18__ may cause harmful elements to form within the plant cells. When we eat colorful fruits and vegetables, the coloring chemicals protect us, too. Typically, an intensely colored plant has __19__ of these protective chemicals than a paler one does. Research on how chemicals in blueberries affect brain function even suggests that these chemicals may help our own brains work more __20__. note: 【你可能會這樣想】however 這個字，你的印象大概只有「出現在句首」那一種擺法，看到它夾在主詞與動詞之間、前後各一個逗號，反而不敢選。【怎麼判斷】這是邏輯勾環，而且線索一定要跨句才看得到。鑑別度高達 60，分開的是認不認得 however 的這個位置。前一句是 The fruits and vegetables we eat often come in distinctive colors（我們吃的蔬果常有鮮明的顏色），讀到這裡的第一印象就是「顏色是為了好看」；空格這一句 The rich colors are not there only to attract attention（這些濃豔的顏色並不只是為了吸引目光）把那個印象翻過來，是轉折，所以填 however。位置的部分：however 屬於連接副詞，可以出現在副詞能出現的任何位置（劍橋 English Grammar Today），夾在主詞與動詞之間、前後各加一個逗號是常見的擺法。填進去讀成 The rich colors, however, are not there only to attract attention。【誘答選項】almost（幾乎）、rarely（很少）、relatively（相對地）三個都是副詞、都能插在這個位置，形態吻合，容易被順手選走，但都不表轉折：almost 是「差一點、幾乎」、rarely 是否定的頻率（讀成「很少不只是為了吸引目光」繞不通）、relatively 需要一個比較的基準。【常考字詞與句型】however（然而，連接副詞，位置靈活）、nevertheless（儘管如此）、come in（有……的樣式或顏色）、attract attention（吸引目光）、perform a function（發揮功能）、relatively（相對地）。

sentence: Plants make antioxidants to protect themselves from the sun's ultraviolet (UV) light, __18__ may cause harmful elements to form within the plant cells.
explanation: which 引導非限定關係子句，先行詞是前面的 the sun's ultraviolet (UV) light（紫外線），補充說明「紫外線可能導致植物細胞內產生有害物質」。逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that，what 不能有先行詞，such 不是關係代名詞，都不合。

note: 【你可能會這樣想】which 與 that 都能當關係代名詞，你大概覺得兩個都行，就挑一個讀起來順的。【怎麼判斷】先數句子成分：逗號後面是 ______ may cause harmful elements to form，動詞 may cause 缺一個主詞，所以空格要填的是一個能當主詞的關係代名詞，先行詞是逗號前的 the sun's ultraviolet (UV) light。接著看那個逗號：逗號隔開的是非限定關係子句，只是補充說明，不是用來限定先行詞是哪一個——而非限定關係子句不能用 that，這裡的先行詞是事物，所以用 which（劍橋 English Grammar Today 的 Relative clauses 條目）。還原一次驗算：..., and it may cause harmful elements to form within the plant cells。【誘答選項】that 在限定關係子句裡可以代替 which，但一碰到逗號就不行；what 自己帶著先行詞（等於 the thing that），這一句前面已經有 UV light 當先行詞，再放 what 就多了一個；such 不是關係代名詞，接不上。【常考字詞與句型】逗號 + which（非限定關係子句指事物用 which，不能用 that）、cause A to V（導致 A 做某事）、protect A from B（保護 A 免於 B）、antioxidants（抗氧化物質）、form（形成、產生）、ultraviolet light（紫外線）。

sentence: Typically, an intensely colored plant has __19__ of these protective chemicals than a paler one does.
explanation: 比較級 more...than 固定句型，「顏色越濃的植物，含有的保護性化學物質越多」，符合前文「顏色來自抗氧化物質」的邏輯（顏色濃＝抗氧化物質多）。less 語意相反，most／least 是最高級，不能跟 than 連用。

contextNote: more 或 less 要靠前文「顏色來自抗氧化物質」那句主題句定案
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是 much 與 little 的比較級或最高級，形態很近，你會憑中文挑一個。【怎麼判斷】鑑別度高達 59。先用形態刷一輪：句尾有 than，而最高級不與 than 連用，most 與 least 一步排除。剩下 more 與 less，這一步句內就分不出來了——空格前是 an intensely colored plant（顏色濃豔的植物），than 後面是 a paler one（顏色較淡的），但顏色濃到底代表那些化學物質多還是少，這一句自己沒有講。要回到前面那句主題句：The colors come mainly from chemicals known as antioxidants（這些顏色主要來自被稱為抗氧化物質的化學物質）。顏色既然是那些物質造出來的，顏色越濃就代表物質越多，所以填 more。填進去讀成 has more of these protective chemicals than a paler one does。另外留意句尾那個 does：它代替的是前面整串 has ... of these protective chemicals，免得同樣的話再說一次。這與 Do you like it?—Yes, I do. 是同一件事，用助動詞把重複的部分頂掉。比較句的句尾常常就掛著這樣一個 does、did 或 is，看到它先問一句「它在代替前面哪一串」，句子的骨幹就清楚了。【誘答選項】less 方向剛好相反；most 與 least 是最高級，不能與 than 連用，而且最高級前面通常要有 the。【常考字詞與句型】more of + 名詞 ... than（比……有更多的）、the + 最高級（最……的，不與 than 連用）、than + 主詞 + does（助動詞代替前面重複的動詞部分）、intensely colored（顏色濃豔的）、pale（顏色淡的、蒼白的）、protective（保護性的）。

sentence: Gateway drugs are substances people take that __21__ them to take more drugs.
explanation: 關係子句的主詞是先行詞 substances（複數），動詞用不加 -s 的現在式 lead；leads 是單數形，leading 不能單獨當動詞，led 當過去式又與全段的現在式不合。
fullPassage: Recent studies have shown that alcohol is the leading gateway drug for teenagers. Gateway drugs are substances people take that __21__ them to take more drugs. Alcohol works directly on the central nervous system and alters one's moods and limits judgment. Since its way of altering moods (changing one's state of mind) is generally expected and socially acceptable, oftentimes it __22__ over drinking. Habitual drinkers may find alcohol not stimulating enough __23__ and want to seek other more stimulating substances. __24__ a circumstance often preconditions teenagers to the possibility of taking other drugs such as marijuana, cocaine or heroin. Another reason why alcohol is the main gateway drug is that the __25__ of teenagers it can affect is very wide. It is easily accessible in most societies and common in popular events such as sports gatherings and dinner parties.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】空格前面最近的名詞是 people（複數）也好、往前一點是 substances（複數）也好，你可能被中間的 people take 干擾，以為主詞是別的字，於是挑了 leads。【怎麼判斷】先找關係代名詞代替的是誰：完整結構是 Gateway drugs are substances (that people take) that ___ them to take more drugs.——第二個 that 的先行詞是 substances（那些物質），所以動詞要配合複數，用不加 -s 的現在式 lead。把中間的 people take 用括號括起來，句子的骨幹就清楚了。再確認語意：lead sb to V ＝ 促使某人去做某事：What led you to change your mind?（是什麼促使你改變心意？）本句是「這些物質促使人去用更多毒品」——主動去促使的是「物質」，不是「人」。【誘答選項】leads：第三人稱單數，只有在主詞是單數時才對，但關係代名詞 that 代替的是複數的 substances。leading：現在分詞，沒有時態，不能單獨當關係子句的動詞，要用它得寫成 are leading。led：若當過去式，文法上可以當子句的動詞，但這一段在說明通則，動詞全是現在式（are、take、works、alters），這裡沒有理由改成過去；若當過去分詞，前面缺 have 或 be，不能單獨當動詞。【常考字詞與句型】lead sb to V（促使某人做…）、lead to（導致）、a gateway drug（入門毒品）、關係子句的動詞一致（動詞配合先行詞）。

sentence: Habitual drinkers may find alcohol not stimulating enough __23__ and want to seek other more stimulating substances.
explanation: after a while 意為「過一段時間之後」：習慣性飲酒者過一陣子會覺得酒精刺激不夠，轉而尋求更強的物質；in advance（事先）、in the least（一點也不）、at most（至多）語意都不合。

note: 【你可能會這樣想】while 你最熟的是連接詞「當…時」，不太容易想到 a while 是名詞片語「一段時間」：after a while（過一陣子）、for a while（有一陣子）、in a while（再過一會兒）、once in a while（偶爾）。「while 當名詞時多半帶著 a」，這是與連接詞用法最好分辨的地方。【怎麼判斷】線索是 habitual：主詞是 Habitual drinkers（習慣性飲酒者）——「習慣性」本身就隱含時間累積，喝久了才會覺得不夠刺激。前一句提到飲酒改變情緒的方式一般可預期、社會也能接受，本句接著講長期下來的變化，下一句再說青少年因而更容易接觸其他毒品。整段是一條時間推移的線。【誘答選項】in advance：「事先、提前」，時間方向相反，喝久了才覺得不夠刺激，不是事先就覺得。in the least：「一點也（不）」，用來把否定推到底（not in the least interested 一點興趣也沒有）；但本句說的是 not stimulating enough（不夠刺激），enough 已經把程度界定在「不夠」而不是「完全沒有」，再加「一點也不」反而自相矛盾，後半句也只說要找更刺激的東西，沒有說酒精毫無刺激。at most：「至多、最多」，用在數量或程度的上限（At most, the work will take a week.），放在 not stimulating enough 後面讀不出意思。【常考字詞與句型】after a while（過一陣子）、for a while（有一陣子）、once in a while（偶爾）、in advance（事先）、not in the least（一點也不）。

explanation: Such a circumstance（這樣的情況）指代前一句提到的情形，作句子主詞，符合承接前文、指代具體情境的語意。Since（自從/因為）、As（當/如同）都不能修飾名詞構成主詞、All 語意不合，都不符合。

note: 【你可能會這樣想】Since 與 As 都很眼熟，你會直覺把這一格讀成「因為……」或「當……時」，然後開始找後面的子句。【怎麼判斷】答對率四成二，鑑別度高達 54。先數句子成分：空格後面是 a circumstance（一個單數名詞組），再往後是 often preconditions（動詞），整句缺的是主詞。所以空格要填的必須是一個能修飾 a circumstance、把它變成主詞的字。Since 與 As 當連接詞時，後面的 a circumstance often preconditions... 成了從屬子句，整句就少了主要子句；當介系詞時（since last year、as a child），a circumstance 成了介系詞的受詞，preconditions 又少了主詞；All 後面接複數或不可數名詞，不能接 a。只剩 Such——such a + 單數名詞就是「這樣的一個……」。填進去讀成 Such a circumstance often preconditions teenagers...（這樣的情況往往讓青少年更容易……）。而「這樣的」指的就是前一句那個狀況：習慣性飲酒的人覺得酒精不夠刺激、想找更刺激的東西。【誘答選項】Since（因為、自從）與 As（當……時、因為）不論當連接詞還是介系詞，填進去句子都不完整；All 若要接 circumstance 得寫成 All circumstances（複數），這一句用的是 a circumstance。【常考字詞與句型】such a + 單數名詞（這樣的一個……）、such + 複數名詞（這樣的……）、precondition sb to（使某人預先傾向於）、habitual drinkers（習慣性飲酒的人）、stimulating（刺激的、令人振奮的）、seek other substances（尋求其他物質）。

sentence: A new year means a new beginning for most of us. On December 28th last year, the New York City sanitation department offered people a new way __26__ farewell to 2007.
explanation: 不定詞片語 to bid 修飾名詞 way，a way to bid farewell（一種道別的方式）是常見的「名詞 + 不定詞」修飾結構。bid（原形）不能直接修飾名詞、bidding（動名詞，此處不符合「方式」的慣用搭配）、bidden（過去分詞，被動語意不合）都不合。
fullPassage: A new year means a new beginning for most of us. On December 28th last year, the New York City sanitation department offered people a new way __26__ farewell to 2007. note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項的中文有兩個都能講成「之前、事先」，你會想從語意挑一個順的。但這兩個靠語意分不出來，真正決定答案的是詞性——空格後面接了什麼，就決定了空格能放什麼。【怎麼判斷】先看空格後面：緊接著 the event，是一個名詞。後面是名詞，前面就要放介系詞。四個選項裡能當介系詞用、後面直接接名詞的有 until 與 prior to；prior to 是兩個字合起來當一個介系詞，等於 before。這一步先刷掉 above all 與 beforehand，剩下兩個再比語意。這個順序可以固定下來，往後遇到同型的題目都能用：空格後面是名詞，就找介系詞；是完整子句（有主詞有動詞），就找連接詞；後面什麼都沒有、直接接逗號或句號，才輪到副詞。再用文意確認一次。本句 as the organizers had announced ___ the event 用了過去完成式 had announced，本身就標示這是更早之前發生的動作，與「在…之前」的語意吻合。順帶把意思相近但詞性不同的一組整理起來，寫作時最容易用錯的就是這幾個：before 既是介系詞也是連接詞（before the event ／ before the event started）；prior to 只能當介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞；beforehand 與 in advance 是副詞，單獨使用、多半放句尾。【誘答選項】beforehand 的中文與 prior to 幾乎相同，都是「事先」，但它是副詞，只能單獨用（Let me know beforehand. 請事先告訴我），後面不能再接名詞，寫成 beforehand the event 不成立——這一題的分界就在這裡。until 是「直到」，會讀成「宣布直到活動為止」，時間關係講不通。above all 是「最重要的是」，屬於轉折詞，用來標示重點，與時間先後無關，而且它後面也不接名詞。【常考字詞與句型】prior to + N／V-ing（在…之前）、before + N／子句（在…之前）、beforehand（事先，副詞）、in advance（事先）、subsequent to（在…之後）、announce（宣布）。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：prior to，後面接名詞的「在…之前」
readMore.hint: 重點：prior to 是多字介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞（prior to the event、prior to signing）；beforehand 與 in advance 是副詞，後面不接名詞。

sentence: Former schoolteacher Eileen Lawrence won the event's $250 award for the most creative memory destined for __30__ .
explanation: 定冠詞 the machine 指前文已提及的那台特定的碎紙機（a huge paper-cutting machine），destined for the machine 表示「注定要被送進（那台特定的）機器」。machine（無冠詞不合單數可數名詞用法）、machines（複數，語境只有一台）、a machine（不定冠詞，語境應指特定那台）都不符合。
fullPassage: A new year means a new beginning for most of us. On December 28th last year, the New York City sanitation department offered people a new way __26__ farewell to 2007. Everything from photos of ex-lovers to lousy report cards could be cut into small pieces, as the organizers had announced __28__ the event. Recycling cans were also provided for items such as __29__ CDs and regrettable fashion mistakes. Former schoolteacher Eileen Lawrence won the event's $250 award for the most creative memory destined for __30__. note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是同一個名詞 machine 的變化，只差冠詞與單複數，你會覺得差別不大，隨手挑一個。【怎麼判斷】答對率剛過五成。這是指標勾環，關鍵在冠詞。machine 是可數名詞，單數不能沒有冠詞就用在句子裡，所以無冠詞的 machine 先排除。剩下三個要看指的是什麼：前文說的是 a huge paper-cutting machine was set up in Times Square（時代廣場架了一台大型碎紙機），全場就那一台。既然是前面已經提過、而且是特定的那一台，就要用定冠詞 the machine。填進去讀成 the most creative memory destined for the machine（最有創意、注定要被送進那台機器的回憶）。這裡用到的冠詞規則是：第一次提到用 a，之後再提到那同一個東西改用 the。【誘答選項】machines 是複數，但活動現場只有一台；a machine 是「某一台機器」，隨便哪一台都算，與「前面提過的那一台」不同；machine 無冠詞不合單數可數名詞的用法。【常考字詞與句型】the + 名詞（回指前面提過的那一個）、a + 名詞（第一次提到某一個）、be destined for（注定要去、注定要成為）、win an award（獲獎）、be happy to V（樂於、很高興做某事）、creative（有創意的）。

sentence: As a result, students are forced to communicate clearly __13__ that the “patient” understands them completely.
explanation: 【句型】in order that + 子句，固定用法，表示「以便、為了使……」，in order that the patient understands 符合「學生必須清楚溝通，以便讓病人完全理解」的目的語意。in return（作為回報）、in case（以防萬一）、in addition（此外）都不符合這種「目的」語意。
fullPassage: Keele University in the United Kingdom has developed a “virtual patient,” created by a computer, to help train the pharmacists of the future. Students in the university's School of __11__ work with the “patient” to gain experience in effective communication and decision-making. As a result, students are forced to communicate clearly __13__ that the “patient” understands them completely. The Virtual Patient can also be used to explore various medical situations. For example, the “patient” can be programmed to be allergic to certain medicine and can __14__ serious reactions if student learners are not aware of the situation. This kind of practice allows students to learn from mistakes in a safe environment that would not be __15__ with textbooks alone. The unique system can both be used in a classroom setting or for distance learning.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是 in 開頭的片語，長得很像，容易混淆，你會憑哪個中文順挑一個。【怎麼判斷】鑑別度高達 55，分開的是有沒有注意到空格後面那個 that。空格後是 that the “patient” understands them completely，一個完整的 that 子句；四個選項裡只有 in order 能直接接 that 子句組成 in order that（以便、為了使……），那是表目的的連接詞。填進去讀成 communicate clearly in order that the patient understands them completely（清楚溝通，好讓病人完全聽懂）。同一個意思的三種說法可以一起記：in order that + 子句、so that + 子句、in order to + 原形動詞。【誘答選項】in return（作為回報）可以單獨用，或接 for + 名詞，不接 that 子句；in case 雖然也能接子句，但它是「以防萬一」，會讀成「以防病人完全聽懂」，語意剛好相反；in addition（此外）是轉折詞，後面要接一個獨立的句子或 to + 名詞，接不上這裡的 that 子句。三個都是 in 開頭的片語，形態吻合，容易被順手選走。【常考字詞與句型】in order that + 子句（以便、為了使……）、in order to + 原形動詞（為了）、in return for（作為……的回報）、in addition to（除……之外）、be forced to V（被迫做某事）、communicate clearly（清楚溝通）。

sentence: The dowry system, money or property brought by a bride to her husband at marriage, was started centuries ago with the intention of providing security for a girl __16__ difficulties and unexpected circumstances after marriage.
explanation: in case of 意為「以防、萬一發生…時」：嫁妝制度原是為了讓女子在婚後遇到困難或突發狀況時有所保障；due to（由於）、apart from（除…之外）、with reference to（關於）語意都不合。
fullPassage: In spite of modernization and the increasing role of women in all walks of life, the practice of the dowry in India is still widespread. The dowry system, money or property brought by a bride to her husband at marriage, was started centuries ago with the intention of providing security for a girl __16__ difficulties and unexpected circumstances after marriage. For this purpose, the parents gave __17__ they could to their daughter, which consequently went to the groom's family. By the beginning of the 21st century, however, the custom had deteriorated to a point whereby the groom and his family had become very __18__. When demands for dowry are not met, the bride is __19__ torture, and often even killed. The more educated a man is, the __20__ is the expectation for dowry at the time of marriage. note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是幾個字合起來當一個介系詞用（劍橋 English Grammar Today 的 Prepositions 條目），中文翻起來都通順，只能靠語意的方向判斷。in case of ＝ 萬一發生…時，帶有「預先防範」的意味：In case of fire, use the stairs.（萬一失火，請走樓梯）。【怎麼判斷】線索是 security：空格前面是 providing security for a girl（為女子提供保障）——既然是「保障」，後面接的必然是「萬一遇到什麼狀況」，這兩個概念天生配成一對。「看到 security、protection、insurance 這類字，後面常接 in case of 或 against。」in case 的兩種用法：in case of + 名詞（萬一發生…）；in case + 子句（以防…）：Take an umbrella in case it rains.（帶把傘以防下雨）。【誘答選項】due to：「由於」，會變成「因為婚後的困難而提供保障」，因果顛倒，保障是預先給的，困難還沒發生。apart from：「除…之外」，讀成「除了婚後的困難之外提供保障」，說不通。with reference to：「關於」，是正式書信用語（I am writing with reference to your letter.），用來點出所談的主題，放在這裡與「保障」接不起來。【常考字詞與句型】in case of fire／emergency（萬一失火／發生緊急狀況）、in case（以防…）、provide security for（為…提供保障）、insure against（為…投保）。

sentence: For this purpose, the parents gave __17__ they could to their daughter, which consequently went to the groom's family.
explanation: whatever 引導名詞子句作 gave 的受詞，表示「父母把他們能給的一切都給了女兒」。whoever（無論是誰，指人）、whenever（無論何時）、whichever（無論哪一個，通常有限定範圍的選項）都不符合這裡泛指「所有能給的東西」的語意。
fullPassage: In spite of modernization and the increasing role of women in all walks of life, the practice of the dowry in India is still widespread. The dowry system, money or property brought by a bride to her husband at marriage, was started centuries ago with the intention of providing security for a girl __16__ difficulties and unexpected circumstances after marriage. For this purpose, the parents gave __17__ they could to their daughter, which consequently went to the groom's family. By the beginning of the 21st century, however, the custom had deteriorated to a point whereby the groom and his family had become very __18__. When demands for dowry are not met, the bride is __19__ torture, and often even killed. The more educated a man is, the __20__ is the expectation for dowry at the time of marriage. Girls who are highly educated are required to have larger dowries because they usually marry more educated men.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是 wh- 加 -ever，長得一模一樣，你會憑中文挑一個。【怎麼判斷】先看空格在句子裡的位置：gave ______ they could to their daughter，動詞 gave 後面缺一個受詞，也就是給出去的東西，空格就是要填那個受詞。所以空格要的是一個自己帶著先行詞、整包當名詞用的複合關係詞。四個選項照語意分流：whoever 指人（等於 anyone who）、whenever 指時間、whichever 是在已經限定好的一組裡挑一個、whatever 指事物而且範圍開放（等於 anything that）。父母給出去的是東西，而且是「所有能給的」，範圍沒有限定，所以用 whatever。還原一次驗算：the parents gave anything that they could (give) to their daughter。順帶留意句尾 they could 後面的動詞被省略了，省掉的正是重複的 give，這與 Do you like it?—Yes, I do. 是同一件事，重複的部分不必再說一次。【誘答選項】whoever 會讀成「父母把能給的人都給了女兒」；whenever 引導的是時間副詞子句，不能當 gave 的受詞；whichever 要求前面先限定好一組東西讓你挑，這一句沒有那一組。三個都是 wh- 加 -ever 的形態，形態吻合，容易被順手選走。【常考字詞與句型】whatever 等於 anything that（無論什麼、任何……的東西）、whoever 等於 anyone who（無論是誰）、whichever（無論哪一個，範圍已限定）、the dowry system（嫁妝制度）、the groom's family（新郎家）、consequently（結果、因此）。

sentence: The more educated a man is, the __20__ is the expectation for dowry at the time of marriage.
explanation: 【句型】The more..., the more.../比較級, 固定句型，「男方教育程度越高，對嫁妝的期望就越高」，higher 呼應前面 more educated 的正向遞增關係。lower（語意相反）、better／worse（語意不精確，此處需明確表達「程度更高」）都不符合。
fullPassage: In spite of modernization and the increasing role of women in all walks of life, the practice of the dowry in India is still widespread. The dowry system, money or property brought by a bride to her husband at marriage, was started centuries ago with the intention of providing security for a girl __16__ difficulties and unexpected circumstances after marriage. For this purpose, the parents gave __17__ they could to their daughter, which consequently went to the groom's family. By the beginning of the 21st century, however, the custom had deteriorated to a point whereby the groom and his family had become very __18__. When demands for dowry are not met, the bride is __19__ torture, and often even killed. The more educated a man is, the __20__ is the expectation for dowry at the time of marriage. Girls who are highly educated are required to have larger dowries because they usually marry more educated men.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是比較級，形態一樣，你會憑中文哪個順挑一個。【怎麼判斷】答對率四成五。先認出句型：The more educated a man is, the ______ is the expectation for dowry。這是「the + 比較級, the + 比較級」的句型，兩個 the 後面各配一個比較級，意思是「越……就越……」。四個選項都是比較級，這一步刷不掉，關鍵在方向與搭配。前半是 more educated（受教育程度越高），後半的主詞是 the expectation for dowry（對嫁妝的期望），兩者同方向遞增，所以要用 higher（更高的）。為什麼是 high 而不是 good 或 bad：expectation 這個字習慣配 high 與 low（high expectations），這是字詞搭配的問題，不是評價好壞。填進去讀成 the higher is the expectation for dowry（對嫁妝的期望就越高）。末句也能驗算：受過高等教育的女子被要求準備更多嫁妝，因為她們多半嫁給學歷更高的男子。【誘答選項】lower（更低的）方向剛好相反；better（更好的）與 worse（更糟的）是在評價好壞，但這一句要的是期望的高低，而 expectation 不與 good、bad 搭配。三個都是比較級，形態吻合，容易被順手選走。【常考字詞與句型】the + 比較級, the + 比較級（越……就越……）、high expectations（很高的期望）、live up to expectations（達到期望）、be required to V（被要求做某事）、at the time of（在……的時候）、highly educated（受過高等教育的）。

sentence: If we used more of this source of heat and light, it __12__ all the power needed throughout the world.
explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣：If + 過去式（used）, 主要子句用 could/would + 原形動詞，could supply 符合這種假設語氣的公式。supplies（直述句現在式）、has supplied（現在完成式）、was supplying（過去進行式）都不符合假設語氣的動詞形式配對。
fullPassage: The sun is an extraordinarily powerful source of energy. In fact, the Earth __11__ 20,000 times more energy from the sun than we currently use. If we used more of this source of heat and light, it __12__ all the power needed throughout the world. We can harness energy from the sun, or solar energy, in many ways. For instance, many satellites in space are equipped with large panels whose solar cells transform sunlight directly __13__ electric power. These panels are covered with glass and are painted black inside to absorb as much heat as possible. Solar energy has a lot to offer. To begin with, it is a clean fuel. In contrast, fossil fuels, such as oil or coal, release __14__ substances into the air when they are burned. __15__, fossil fuels will run out, but solar energy will continue to reach the Earth long after the last coal has been mined and the last oil well has run dry.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】看到 If 你大概直接讀成「如果……就……」，順手填一個現在式進去；但這一句的 If 子句用的是過去式 used，那正是一個訊號。【怎麼判斷】鑑別度高達 58，分開的是有沒有先看 If 子句的動詞形態。If 子句寫的是 used（過去式），可是講的並不是過去的事——太陽現在就在那裡，是我們現在沒有多用它。這就是與現在事實相反的假設語氣：動詞倒推一個時態，現在的事改用過去式，公式是 If + 過去式，主要子句用 would／could／might + 原形動詞。常見的例子是 If I were you, I would tell him.（我不可能是你，所以 were 配 would）。四個選項裡只有 could supply 符合這個形態，填進去讀成 it could supply all the power needed throughout the world（它就能供應全世界所需的電力）。【誘答選項】supplies 是現在式，會把整句讀成單純的條件句，與 If 子句的過去式對不上；has supplied 是現在完成式、was supplying 是過去進行式，兩個都在陳述已經發生或當時正在發生的事實，與「假設」剛好相反。三個都是 supply 的形態，形態吻合，容易被順手選走。【常考字詞與句型】If + 過去式，S + would／could + 原形動詞（與現在事實相反的假設語氣）、If I were you（如果我是你）、supply A with B（供應 A 以 B）、harness energy（利用、駕馭能源）、throughout the world（全世界）、all the power needed（所需的全部電力）。

note: 【你可能會這樣想】transform 的中文是「轉變」，你很可能想成「從陽光轉變過來」而選 from，方向剛好搞反。【怎麼判斷】先確認空格前後各是什麼：前面是 transform sunlight（把陽光轉變），後面是 electric power（電力）。轉變一定有起點與終點，這一句的起點 sunlight 已經寫在動詞後面，electric power 是終點；transform A into B 的 into 標的正是終點——變成什麼。填進去讀成 transform sunlight directly into electric power（把陽光直接轉換成電力）。同一組的說法可以一起記：change A into B、turn A into B、translate A into B，介系詞一律用 into。【誘答選項】from 標的是起點，但起點已經寫出來了，再用 from 會變成兩個起點；with 標的是工具或伴隨的東西，電力不是拿來轉換的工具；off 講的是離開表面或關掉，接不上 transform。【常考字詞與句型】transform A into B（把 A 轉變成 B）、turn A into B（把 A 變成 B）、be equipped with（配備有）、absorb heat（吸收熱能）、solar cells（太陽能電池）、electric power（電力）。

sentence: Solar energy has a lot to offer. To begin with, it is a clean fuel…… __15__ , fossil fuels will run out, but solar energy will continue to reach the Earth long after the last coal has been mined and the last oil well has run dry.
explanation: What's more（此外、而且）承接前面「太陽能是乾淨燃料」這個優點，繼續補充第二個優點（不會枯竭），是累加式的列點語氣。Otherwise（否則）、Therefore（因此）、In comparison（相比之下）都不符合這種「還有一點」的累加語意。
fullPassage: The sun is an extraordinarily powerful source of energy. In fact, the Earth __11__ 20,000 times more energy from the sun than we currently use. If we used more of this source of heat and light, it __12__ all the power needed throughout the world. We can harness energy from the sun, or solar energy, in many ways. For instance, many satellites in space are equipped with large panels whose solar cells transform sunlight directly __13__ electric power. These panels are covered with glass and are painted black inside to absorb as much heat as possible. Solar energy has a lot to offer. To begin with, it is a clean fuel. In contrast, fossil fuels, such as oil or coal, release __14__ substances into the air when they are burned. __15__, fossil fuels will run out, but solar energy will continue to reach the Earth long after the last coal has been mined and the last oil well has run dry.
contextNote: What's more 承接 To begin with，補上太陽能的第二項好處
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是轉折詞，你知道要看前後關係，但這一段前後好像都在講化石燃料的不好，方向看起來一樣，一時分不出該用哪一個。【怎麼判斷】答對率五成一，鑑別度高達 68，是同一年克漏字十題裡最高的，分開的是有沒有看出這一段在列清單。這是邏輯勾環，而且線索要往前跨兩句才完整：Solar energy has a lot to offer（太陽能有很多好處）先開了一個清單，To begin with, it is a clean fuel（首先，它是乾淨的燃料）是清單上的第一項。空格這一句講的是第二項——化石燃料會用完，太陽能不會。既然是在同一個清單上再加一項，用的就是累加的轉折詞 What's more（此外、而且）。填進去讀成 What's more, fossil fuels will run out, but solar energy will continue to reach the Earth。填不出來的時候，先確認這一段是不是在列清單、空格落在第幾項，往往一步就定案。【誘答選項】Therefore（因此）要求後面是前面造成的結果，但化石燃料會枯竭並不是「排放有害物質」造成的；In comparison（相比之下）與前一句開頭的 In contrast 撞在一起，同一組對比連著用兩次讀不通，而且這一句真正在做的是加一項、不是再比一次；Otherwise（否則）要求前面先有一個條件或指示，這裡沒有。【常考字詞與句型】what's more（此外、而且）、to begin with（首先）、run out（用完、耗盡）、run dry（枯竭、乾涸）、in comparison（相比之下）、have a lot to offer（有很多好處可提供）。

sentence: The Louvre's Tactile Gallery, targeted at the blind and visually __17__ , is the only space in the museum where visitors can touch the sculptures, with no guards or alarms to stop them.
explanation: 過去分詞 impaired 作形容詞，visually impaired（視覺受損的）是描述視障人士的常見固定用語，與 the blind 對等並列，共同修飾這個藝廊的服務對象。impair（原形動詞）、impairs（限定動詞）、impairing（現在分詞，主動語意不合，視障是被動狀態）都不合。
fullPassage: Signs asking visitors to keep their hands off the art are everywhere in the Louvre Museum, Paris. But one special sculpture gallery invites art lovers to allow their hands to __16__ the works. The Louvre's Tactile Gallery, targeted at the blind and visually __17__, is the only space in the museum where visitors can touch the sculptures, with no guards or alarms to stop them. Its latest exhibit is a __18__ of sculpted lions, snakes, horses and eagles. The 15 animals exhibited are reproductions of famous works found elsewhere in the Louvre. Called “Animals, Symbols of Power,” the exhibit __19__ animals that were used by kings and emperors throughout history to symbolize the greatness of their reigns. The exhibit, opened in December 2008, __20__ scheduled to run for about three years. During guided tours on the weekends, children can explore the art with blindfolds on.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項是同一個字 impair 的四種形態，你會直覺開始分主動被動、找意義主詞。【怎麼判斷】先看它跟誰並列：targeted at the blind and visually ______，and 連的是 the blind（視障者）與空格這一串，兩邊都是這個展廳服務的人。空格前的 visually 是副詞，副詞可以修飾形容詞或分詞，空格要填的就是 visually 所修飾、當形容詞用的那個字。再判方向：視覺是「受到損害」的一方，不是自己去損害別人，所以用過去分詞 impaired。visually impaired 是講視障最常見的說法，整組記起來就好。填進去讀成 the blind and visually impaired（視障與視覺受損的人）。鑑別度只有 35，但它本身不難：副詞後面接分詞、加上「受損」要用被動這兩層，各種程度的人都答得出來，題目自然分不出高低。【誘答選項】impair 與 impairs 填進去都得當動詞用，這裡卻沒有主詞或助動詞可以搭；impairing 是現在分詞、表示主動去損害別人，方向相反。【常考字詞與句型】visually impaired（視覺受損的、視障的）、hearing-impaired（聽覺受損的）、impair（損害、削弱）、be targeted at（針對……而設）、the + 形容詞（表一群人，the blind 視障者）、sculpture（雕塑作品）。

sentence: The exhibit, opened in December 2008, __20__ scheduled to run for about three years.
explanation: opened in December 2008 是插入的分詞片語，用來修飾主詞 The exhibit，句子仍缺一個限定動詞，故填 is，構成 be scheduled to（預定）；being 與 having 都是分詞，has 則會使語態變成主動而不合。
fullPassage: Signs asking visitors to keep their hands off the art are everywhere in the Louvre Museum, Paris. But one special sculpture gallery invites art lovers to allow their hands to __16__ the works. The Louvre's Tactile Gallery, targeted at the blind and visually __17__, is the only space in the museum where visitors can touch the sculptures, with no guards or alarms to stop them. Its latest exhibit is a __18__ of sculpted lions, snakes, horses and eagles. The 15 animals exhibited are reproductions of famous works found elsewhere in the Louvre. Called “Animals, Symbols of Power,” the exhibit __19__ animals that were used by kings and emperors throughout history to symbolize the greatness of their reigns. The exhibit, opened in December 2008, __20__ scheduled to run for about three years. During guided tours on the weekends, children can explore the art with blindfolds on.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】句子中間插了 opened in December 2008，你看到 opened 就當它是主要動詞，覺得句子已經完整，於是不知道空格要填什麼。這個分詞片語只是修飾主詞，等於 which was opened in December 2008。【怎麼判斷】讀英文句子，先抓兩樣東西：誰、怎麼了——主詞與動詞。這兩樣定了，其餘都是掛在上面的修飾語。先把句子切開看：[The exhibit], opened in December 2008, ___ scheduled to run for about three years. 方括號裡是主詞，緊接著兩個逗號夾住一段修飾語；把它遮掉，剩下 [The exhibit] ___ scheduled…，動詞該站的位置立刻現形。眼睛先撞到 opened 就把它當成動詞，是這一題最容易出的錯。主詞後面接逗號的句子都可以這樣處理：先確認逗號之間是不是修飾語（分詞片語、同位語、介系詞片語），是就遮掉。骨幹露出來之後，要填的是一個有時態的動詞。scheduled 在這裡是過去分詞——展覽是「被安排」的一方，所以要配 be 動詞構成 be scheduled to V（預定要…）。主詞 The exhibit 單數，全文用現在式敘述現況，因此填 is。這個結構很常見：The boy standing there is my brother.（站在那裡的男孩是我哥哥。）standing there 是修飾語，is 才是主要動詞。本題只多兩件事——修飾語換成過去分詞，是被動；而且用兩個逗號插在主詞與動詞中間，把兩者隔得比較開，更容易看走眼。【誘答選項】being 與 having 都是分詞、沒有時態，當不了主要動詞，填進去整句會變成一個沒有動詞的名詞片語。has 的問題不同：has scheduled 是主動語態，意思變成「展覽安排了某件事」，但展覽是被安排的一方，語態顛倒；要用 has，得寫成 has been scheduled 才通。這個方法在學測 104 年第 18 題也考過同一個概念：These movements, forming an exercise system, ___ one to effortlessly experience the vital life force, or the Qi energy, in one's body.——插入語換成現在分詞，遮掉之後要判斷的是主詞單複數（These movements 要配 allow）。學測 108 年第 17 題是第三種：However, many people, either refusing to accept the new date or not having heard about it, ___ to celebrate New Year’s Day on April 1.——插入語是兩個並列的分詞片語，遮掉之後要判斷的是主要動詞的時態（要配 continued）。本題遮掉之後要判斷的是語態。遮住插入語只是第一步，第二步永遠是問：這個主詞跟這個動詞，在數與語態上對得起來嗎？【常考字詞與句型】be scheduled to V（預定要）、be due to V（預計）、be set to V（即將）、run for（持續、上演）。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：限定動詞與非限定動詞——插入的分詞片語不是真正的動詞
readMore.hint: 重點：兩個逗號中間的 opened in December 2008 是分詞片語，用來修飾 The exhibit，不是這一句的動詞，所以真正的動詞還沒出現；being 與 having 是非限定形式，不能單獨當動詞，has 會變成主動的 has scheduled，語意不通。填 is 才組成 be scheduled to（預定）。

sentence: Handling customer claims is a common task for most business firms. These claims include requests to exchange merchandise, requests for refunds, requests that work __11__ , and other requests for adjustments.
explanation: request that 後面的子句要用「(should) + 原形動詞」的假設語氣，且 work（成品）是被修正的對象，須用被動的原形 be corrected；is correct、to be correct、is corrected 都不符合這個結構。
fullPassage: Handling customer claims is a common task for most business firms. These claims include requests to exchange merchandise, requests for refunds, requests that work __11__, and other requests for adjustments. Most of these claims are approved because they are legitimate. However, some requests for adjustment must be __12__, and an adjustment refusal message must be sent. Adjustment refusals are negative messages for the customer. They are necessary when the customer is __13__ or when the vendor has done all that can reasonably or legally be expected. An adjustment refusal message requires your best communication skills __14__ it is bad news to the receiver. You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer __15__. You may refuse the request for adjustment and even try to sell the customer more merchandise or service. All this is happening when the customer is probably angry, disappointed, or inconvenienced.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】看到 that 子句你想填一個有時態的動詞，於是挑 is corrected——文法上看起來很正常，卻踩進陷阱。關鍵在前面的 requests（這裡是名詞）：表示「要求、建議、堅持、命令」的字，後面的 that 子句要用「(should) + 原形動詞」，而 should 通常省略。這一組包括 request、suggest、insist、demand、require、recommend、propose、order。【怎麼判斷】為什麼是原形，不是不加 s？英文的假設語氣沒有專屬的字形，用的就是動詞原形；祈使句用的也是同一個形（Huddleston & Pullum《劍橋英語文法》2002 的界定是：在限定子句裡使用原形，描述的是還沒成為事實的情況）。醫生真正說出口的那句話是 「Stop smoking.」，寫成 The doctor insisted that Pat stop smoking. 時，那個動詞的形沒有變——兩邊講的都是「還沒發生、要促成的動作」。判斷法就從這裡來：that 子句唸起來像在下指令，就用原形；只是在陳述一件事，就照一般規則走。對照 The man insisted that he didn't lie.（他堅稱自己沒說謊），這句是陳述不是命令，didn't 沒有錯。否定的寫法同理，不加 do：She insisted that he not be present.（不會變成 didn't）。同一個考法，反過來考：學測文意選填 101 年第 39 題給的是 it can ___ that the name of the typhoon be deleted（颱風名稱除名），句子裡先擺出原形的 be deleted，要你回頭填前面那個觸發的字，答案就是 request。本題給觸發詞、要你填原形；那題給原形、要你填觸發詞。同一件事從兩頭考，看得懂一邊就看得懂另一邊。被動是從哪裡來的？顧客要求的那件事，說出口就是 Correct the work.（把成品修好）。但這一句的 that 子句已經用 work 當主詞，也就是把受詞 work 提到主詞的位置，動詞就得改成被動。原形加被動，合起來就是 be corrected——不是兩條規則疊在一起，是同一件要求換個主詞說出來。再看一個常見的句子：It is important that he (should) be on time.——同一組，that 子句一樣用原形。觸發的字不限動詞：動詞（suggest、insist、demand、request……）、名詞（a request that……、a suggestion that……）、形容詞（It is essential／important／necessary／vital that……）三類都算，理由都是同一個。【誘答選項】is correct：correct 當形容詞是「正確的」，requests that work is correct 讀成「要求成品是正確的」，但這一格要的是「把成品修正」這個動作；而且 is 是有時態的形式，不是這裡 requests that 後面要的原形。to be correct：不定詞不能直接接在 that 子句的主詞 work 後面當動詞，而且 correct 在這裡同樣是形容詞「正確的」，不是「修正」。is corrected：被動的方向對了，但 is 是直述句的現在式；在正式書面語（本文談的是商業書信）裡，request that 後面的子句用原形 (should) be corrected，與同句並列的 requests to exchange merchandise、requests for refunds 的正式口吻一致。【常考字詞與句型】request／suggest／insist／demand that + S + (should) + 原形動詞（要求、建議、堅持、命令；表示要求時 that 子句用原形）、It is necessary that…（有必要…）、a refund（退款）。

sentence: An adjustment refusal message requires your best communication skills __14__ it is bad news to the receiver. You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer __15__ .
explanation: because 表示因果，「因為這是壞消息，所以需要最好的溝通技巧」，符合語意邏輯。till（直到）、unless（除非）、therefore（因此，此處文法上不能直接連接兩個子句作連接詞用）都不符合這裡的因果關係。
fullPassage: Handling customer claims is a common task for most business firms. These claims include requests to exchange merchandise, requests for refunds, requests that work __11__, and other requests for adjustments. Most of these claims are approved because they are legitimate. However, some requests for adjustment must be __12__, and an adjustment refusal message must be sent. Adjustment refusals are negative messages for the customer. They are necessary when the customer is __13__ or when the vendor has done all that can reasonably or legally be expected. An adjustment refusal message requires your best communication skills __14__ it is bad news to the receiver. You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer __15__. You may refuse the request for adjustment and even try to sell the customer more merchandise or service. All this is happening when the customer is probably angry, disappointed, or inconvenienced.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項的中文都能說成某種關係，therefore 的「因此」尤其眼熟，你會覺得它擺在這裡也通。【怎麼判斷】這是邏輯勾環，但要先解決一個形態問題再談語意。空格後面是 it is bad news to the receiver，一個完整的子句，所以空格要的是連接詞，不是副詞——therefore 是連接副詞，它可以出現在副詞能出現的位置，卻不能拿來把兩個子句接起來（劍橋 English Grammar Today）。這一步就刷掉一個。再看語意：前半是「拒絕調整的信最需要你的溝通技巧」，後半是「因為對收信的人來說這是壞消息」——後面那一句正是前面那一句的原因，所以用 because。填進去讀成 requires your best communication skills because it is bad news to the receiver。【誘答選項】till（直到……為止）標示的是時間的終點，兩件事之間不是時間關係；unless（除非）等於 if...not，會變成「除非這是壞消息，否則就需要溝通技巧」，與整段的意思剛好相反；therefore 是副詞，不能單獨用來連接兩個子句；而且它表示結果，填進去會把因果倒過來，讀成「需要溝通技巧，所以這是壞消息」。【常考字詞與句型】because + 子句（因為，連接詞）、because of + 名詞（因為，後面接名詞）、therefore（因此，連接副詞）、unless（除非，等於 if...not）、bad news（壞消息）、communication skills（溝通技巧）。

sentence: An adjustment refusal message requires your best communication skills __14__ it is bad news to the receiver. You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer __15__ .
explanation: at the same time（同時）表示「你必須拒絕客戶的請求，同時還要留住這位客戶」，符合「拒絕」與「留客」這兩個看似矛盾任務同時進行的語意。by and large（大體上）、over and over（一再地）、for the same reason（基於同樣的理由）都不符合這種「同時兼顧兩件事」的語意。
fullPassage: Handling customer claims is a common task for most business firms. These claims include requests to exchange merchandise, requests for refunds, requests that work __11__, and other requests for adjustments. Most of these claims are approved because they are legitimate. However, some requests for adjustment must be __12__, and an adjustment refusal message must be sent. Adjustment refusals are negative messages for the customer. They are necessary when the customer is __13__ or when the vendor has done all that can reasonably or legally be expected. An adjustment refusal message requires your best communication skills __14__ it is bad news to the receiver. You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer __15__. You may refuse the request for adjustment and even try to sell the customer more merchandise or service. All this is happening when the customer is probably angry, disappointed, or inconvenienced.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是三四個字的片語，你會挑一個中文讀起來最順的擺進去。【怎麼判斷】這是邏輯勾環：要判斷的是同一句裡兩件事之間的關係。整句是 You have to refuse the claim and retain the customer ______.（你必須拒絕這項索賠，並且______留住這位客戶）。拒絕與留住是兩件方向相反的事，卻要在同一封信裡一起做到，這種「一邊……一邊……、然而同時」的關係就是 at the same time。這個片語除了字面的「同時」，還有一層轉折的用法——先承認前面那件事，再提出一件與它拉扯的事，中文常譯成「但另一方面」。填進去讀成 refuse the claim and retain the customer at the same time（拒絕索賠，同時又要把客戶留住）。【誘答選項】over and over（一再地、反覆地）講的是次數，留住客戶不是一件反覆做的事；for the same reason（基於同樣的理由）要回指前面已經講過的理由，可是拒絕索賠又要留住客戶，並不是出於前文的哪一個理由，這一句要補的是兩件事得一起做到；by and large（大體而言）是對整體情況下評語，接在這裡讀不出與「拒絕」的拉扯。【常考字詞與句型】at the same time（同時；但另一方面）、over and over（一再地、反覆地）、for the same reason（基於同樣的理由）、retain a customer（留住客戶）、refuse a claim（拒絕索賠要求）、handle a claim（處理索賠）。

sentence: Cultures sometimes vary greatly in this regard. A group of researchers in Japan, __16__ , studied the facial reactions of students to a horror film.

sentence: Many Americans replace their toothbrushes only once or twice a year. The ADA, however, recommends __12__ a new toothbrush every three to four months.

note: 【你可能會這樣想】recommend 的中文是「建議」，你大概直覺想接不定詞，寫成 recommend to use。但英文裡 recommend 後面要接一個動作時，用的是動名詞或 that 子句，不直接接不定詞。【怎麼判斷】這一題考的是這個動詞要求後面跟什麼形式，屬於用法而非字義，句法一關就能定案。空格前是主要動詞 recommends，空格處要填的是它的受詞。recommend 後面接動作時有兩種寫法：recommend + V-ing（The ADA recommends using a new toothbrush every three to four months.）以及 recommend + that + S + (should) + 原形 V（The ADA recommends that you should use a new toothbrush…）。本句空格後面沒有 that、也沒有主詞，只有名詞片語 a new toothbrush，所以走的是第一種，填 using。驗算法：把兩種寫法都試著唸一遍，能唸通的那一種就是句子要的形式；若填的字讓 recommend 後面既不是動名詞也不是完整子句，那一定不對。這一組要接動名詞的動詞值得一起記：suggest、recommend、avoid、enjoy、finish、mind、practice、consider、admit。與它們對照的是慣接不定詞的那一組：want、hope、plan、decide、promise、agree——這一組多半帶著「還沒做、打算去做」的意味。兩組分開記，寫作時最不容易出錯。【誘答選項】use 是原形動詞，recommend 後面不直接接原形動詞。to use 是不定詞，形式上像個受詞，但 recommend 不收不定詞當受詞，這是這個字的用法規定，記下來就好。used 有兩個身分——過去式與過去分詞，兩種都當不了 recommends 的受詞：當過去式會讓句子出現第二個限定動詞，當過去分詞要修飾後面的 toothbrush，就得放在冠詞後面（a used toothbrush），而且「用過的」與 new 意思相反。【常考字詞與句型】recommend + V-ing（建議做…）、recommend + that + S + (should) + V（建議…）、suggest + V-ing（建議做…）、avoid + V-ing（避免做）、consider + V-ing（考慮做）、mind + V-ing（介意做）、decide + to V（決定做）。

sentence: Through observing chimpanzees' learning process, researchers hope to gain insight into what the development of our earliest ancestors __20__ like.

fullPassage:

note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是 be 動詞的不同形態排在一起，你會立刻認定這是時態題，開始比對前後其他動詞的時態。方向沒錯，但真正的線索不在別的動詞身上，在 our earliest ancestors 這幾個字上。【怎麼判斷】先把句型還原：what sth is like 是問「某樣東西是什麼樣子」，句尾那個 like 是介系詞，前面的 what 正是它的受詞——這也是為什麼句尾的 like 不能拿掉。接著決定時態：談的是 our earliest ancestors（人類最早的祖先）的發展，那是極久以前的事，沒有人親眼看過，只能推測，所以要用對過去的推測 might have been（可能曾經是）。填進去讀成 what the development of our earliest ancestors might have been like。鑑別度只有 32，但它本身不難：might have + 過去分詞是常見的組合，各種程度的人都答得出來，題目自然分不出高低。【誘答選項】is to be 指向未來，但祖先的發展是過去的事，方向相反；will have been 通常是未來完成式，它也能用來推斷已經發生的事（You will have heard about the plans.），但那是說話的人很有把握的推斷，本句講的是只能推測的事，用 might 才合；was to be 是「注定要、預定要」，站在過去往後看、講的是後來果然發生的事（He was to become a famous scientist.），這一句不是在講後來發生了什麼，而是在推測當時的樣子。三個都是 be 的形態，形態吻合，容易被順手選走。【常考字詞與句型】might have been（可能曾經是，對過去的推測）、What is he like?（他是什麼樣的人？）、gain insight into（深入了解、看出門道）、be to V（注定要、預定要）、through V-ing（藉由做某事）、observe（觀察）。

sentence: His writing style, characterized by simplicity and understatement, influenced modern fiction, as __11__ his life of adventure.
explanation: as did his life of adventure 是「as + 助動詞 + 主詞」的倒裝結構，did 代替前面的動詞 influenced，避免重複：他充滿冒險的一生同樣也影響了現代小說；was、being、doing 都無法擔任這個代動詞。
fullPassage:
Ernest Hemingway (1899-1961) was an American author and journalist. His writing style, characterized by simplicity and understatement, influenced modern fiction, as __11__ his life of adventure.
Hemingway started his career as a journalist at 17. In the 1920s, he was sent to Europe as a newspaper correspondent to __12__ such events as the Greek Revolution. During this period, he produced his early important works, including The Sun Also Rises. Among his later works, the most outstanding is The Old Man and the Sea (1952), which became perhaps his most famous book, finally winning him the Pulitzer Prize he had long been __13__ .
Hemingway liked to portray soldiers, hunters, bullfighters—tough, at times primitive people whose courage and honesty are set against the brutal ways of modern society, and who in this __14__ lose hope and faith. His straightforward prose is particularly effective in his short stories, some of __15__ are collected in Men Without Women (1927). In 1954, Hemingway was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature. He died in Idaho in 1961.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】句子讀到 as，你等著看一個完整的子句，結果後面只有一個 did 加一串名詞，會覺得動詞不見了。於是你想把空格填成看起來像動詞的 being 或 doing，把它補成「正在做」的樣子。動詞其實沒有不見——did 就是那個動詞，它代替前面出現過的 influenced，避免同一個字說兩次。【怎麼判斷】讀英文句子，先抓兩樣東西：誰、怎麼了——主詞與動詞。這兩樣定了，其餘大多是修飾語。先把句子切開看：[His writing style], characterized by simplicity and understatement, [influenced] modern fiction, as ___ [his life of adventure]. 方括號裡依序是主詞、主要動詞，以及 as 後面那個新的主詞；中間被兩個逗號夾住的是修飾語，遮掉不影響句子成立。接著看 as 後面：主詞是 his life of adventure，那它的動詞在哪裡？由 did 代替了。驗算只有一步——把 did 還原成它代替的那一串，整句讀成 as his life of adventure influenced modern fiction（他充滿冒險的一生同樣影響了現代小說），句子站得住，方向就對了。這背後是英文避免重複的習慣：同一個動詞不重說第二次，改用一個助動詞代替。So do I.、Neither have I. 也是同一個做法，只是平常多半當整組說法記，不太會去想那個 do 或 have 在代替什麼；這裡把它拆開看，did 代替的是 influenced modern fiction 一整串。還有一點順手分清楚。So have I. 表示「我也是」時一定要倒裝，寫成 So I have. 就成了表示驚訝的回應（「還真的是」），意思不同；本句的 as did his life of adventure 是選擇性的，寫成 as his life of adventure did 一樣正確。本句選前者，是因為英文習慣把長的成分留到句尾——主詞 his life of adventure 比助動詞長得多，助動詞先出來，句子的重量才落在後面。兩種倒裝長得像，規則不同，別把 So have I. 那條「一定要倒裝」直接套過來。【誘答選項】三個選項的錯法各不相同，值得分開記。was 錯在「代錯種類」：代動詞要跟它代替的動詞同一類，前面是 influenced 這個一般動詞，就得用 do 的家族；要用 was，前面得是 be 動詞才行，例如 His style was simple, as was his life.（他的風格簡潔，他的人生也是。）being 與 doing 的問題相同：兩個都是分詞、沒有時態，當不了子句的動詞，而 as 引導的是一個有主詞的子句，需要一個有時態的動詞來搭配。分不出來時回到最基本的一條——一個子句要有自己的主詞與限定動詞，這一格要填的就是 his life of adventure 的那個動詞。【常考字詞與句型】as did ／ as does + 主詞（…也是如此，比較子句的倒裝）、as was ／ as were + 主詞（前面是 be 動詞時用）、so do I（我也是）、neither do I（我也不）、be characterized by（以…為特色）、understatement（含蓄、輕描淡寫）。
discriminationNote: 鑑別度 7，高低分群的差距不大。本題答對率一成四，屬於難度很高的題目——大考中心《選才電子報》第 307 期說明鑑別度時，就把答對率低的難題列為鑑別度偏低的原因之一：高、低分群考生在這類題目上的答對率差距不大，鑑別度的數值就會比較小。這一題比較像是不分程度的考生都在同一個結構前停住：as 後面接的是代動詞加主詞的倒裝，did 代替前面的 influenced，不是一個要跟主詞搭配的 be 動詞。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：as／than 倒裝，用助動詞代替前面出現過的動詞
readMore.hint: 重點：as 引導的比較句重複前面用過的一般動詞時，用 do／does／did 代替並倒裝（動詞放在主詞前面），時態跟被代替的動詞一致；本句前面是 influenced，過去式，所以用 did。was 無法代替一般動詞，being 與 doing 是非限定形式，接不上主詞 his life of adventure。

sentence: His straightforward prose is particularly effective in his short stories, some of __15__ are collected in Men Without Women (1927).
explanation: 【關係代名詞】some of which 中，which 代替前面的先行詞 short stories，引導形容詞子句修飾之；介系詞 of 之後須接關係代名詞 which，不可接 that。what 前面不能有先行詞；them／these 為代名詞，無法直接接在介系詞後方引導子句。
fullPassage:

note: 【你可能會這樣想】some of them 讀起來非常順，中文「其中有些被收錄在……」也完全對得上，所以 them 是這一題最誘人的選項；these 同理。【怎麼判斷】這一題不靠語意，靠數句子的成分。先數限定動詞：逗號前 His straightforward prose is particularly effective in his short stories 已經是一個完整的句子（主詞 prose、動詞 is）；逗號後 some of ______ are collected in Men Without Women 又有一個動詞 are。一個句子裡出現兩個限定動詞，中間卻只有一個逗號、沒有對等連接詞——這時後面那一段一定得靠連接詞或關係詞接上去，四個選項裡能引導子句的只有 what 與 which。接著刷掉 what：劍橋 English Grammar Today 的 what 條目說 what 不能當一般的關係代名詞，前面若已經有名詞先行詞就得改用 which 或 that（This is the book which the lecturer mentioned.，不可寫成 the book what...）。本句前面已經有先行詞 short stories，what 排除。剩下 which，還原成兩句就看得很清楚：His straightforward prose is particularly effective in his short stories. 加上 Some of the short stories are collected in Men Without Women.，把第二句的 the short stories 換成 which 接上去，就是 some of which。這一組整批記起來最省力：some of which、most of which、all of which、none of which。另外記一條：關係代名詞 that 前面不能直接放介系詞（劍橋 English Grammar Today 的 Relative pronouns 條目），所以這裡不能寫成 some of that。【誘答選項】them 與 these 都是代名詞。代名詞只能在句子裡當名詞用，沒有把兩個句子接起來的能力；填進去會變成兩個完整的句子中間只放一個逗號，這在英文裡不成立，中間必須有連接詞或關係詞。中文讀起來順正是它誘人的原因，但英文的連接規則不會因為中文順就放行。what 前面已經有先行詞，理由見上。這一格的鑑別度 52，分開的就是有沒有先數清楚句子裡的動詞與連接詞，而不是憑中文語感。【常考字詞與句型】some of which（其中一些，介系詞加關係代名詞）、most of which（其中大部分）、none of which（其中沒有一個）、be collected in（被收錄於）、straightforward（直截了當的、不繞彎的）、be awarded（被授予）。

sentence: Road running often offers those __19__ a range of challenges such as dealing with hills, sharp bends, rough weather, and so on.
explanation: those involved 是固定用法，意為「參與其中的人」，involved 是過去分詞當形容詞、帶被動語意；involving 為主動，to involve 是不定詞，are involved 會使句子出現兩個限定動詞，中間卻沒有連接詞或關係代名詞。
fullPassage:
Road running is one of the most popular and accessible athletic activities in the world. It refers to the sport of running on paved roads or established paths as opposed to track and field, or cross country running. The three most common __16__ for road running events are 10K runs, half marathons (21.1K), and marathons (42.2K).
Road running is unique among athletic events because it __17__ all ages and abilities. In many cases first time amateurs are welcome to participate in the same event as running club members and even current world-class __18__ . Sometimes it may also include wheelchair entrants.
Road running often offers those __19__ a range of challenges such as dealing with hills, sharp bends, rough weather, and so on. Runners are advised to train prior to participating in a race. Another important factor contributing to success is a suitable pair of running shoes.
Road running is often a community-wide event that highlights or raises money for an issue or project. __20__ , Race for the Cure is held throughout the U.S. to raise breast cancer awareness. This race is also run in Germany, Italy, and Puerto Rico.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】involve 你大概只記得「牽涉」，而且多半見於 be involved in an accident（捲入事故），所以看到 those ___ 這個位置不知道要填什麼。those involved 就是「參與其中的人」，等於 those who are involved，是英文很常用的簡潔說法。【怎麼判斷】這一格填的不是動詞，是說明 those 是哪些人的字。Road running often [offers] [those ___] [a range of challenges] such as dealing with hills. offers 已經是主要動詞，後面兩個方括號是它的兩個受詞，人在前、物在後，這是 offer sb sth 的形狀；空格落在第一個受詞裡面。完整說法是 those who are involved（參與其中的人），把 who are 省掉，就剩下名詞後面直接接分詞。這是形容詞子句的簡化，判斷方式只有一句：名詞在做那個動作用 V-ing，被那個動作影響用 p.p.。人是被牽涉進來的一方，所以用 involved。同一組一起記：the people concerned（相關人士）、the items mentioned（提到的那幾項）、the students selected（獲選的學生）。順帶一提，involved 也可以是過去式動詞，所以有人會把 those involved a range of challenges 讀成一個完整句子（那些人牽涉了一連串挑戰）。但這樣切，offers 就沒有受詞了，切不通。【誘答選項】involving 是現在分詞，方向相反——人是被牽涉的一方，不是去牽涉別人。to involve 放在名詞後面表示「將要做的、有待做的」（the work to do 待辦的工作），與後面的挑戰接不上。are involved 是有時態的動詞，而有時態的動詞不能直接放在名詞後面當修飾語，要用它就得補回關係代名詞，寫成 those who are involved。【常考字詞與句型】those involved（參與其中的人）、the people concerned（相關人士）、be involved in（涉入、參與）、get involved（參與其中）、offer sb sth（提供某人某物）、involvement（參與）。

sentence: Road running is often a community-wide event that highlights or raises money for an issue or project. __20__ , Race for the Cure is held throughout the U.S. to raise breast cancer awareness.
explanation: 【轉折詞】前句概括說明「路跑常是社區性活動，用以宣傳議題或募款」，後句以 Race for the Cure 為具體實例，故用 For example（舉例）承接。Above all（最重要的是）、As it appears（看來）、To some extent（在某種程度上）都不符合舉例語境。

note: 【你可能會這樣想】四個選項都是擺在句首的轉承說法，中文讀起來好像都能硬接，尤其 Above all（最重要的是）看起來像在加強語氣，很容易覺得說得通。【怎麼判斷】轉折詞是最好認的邏輯勾環，判斷方式只有一句——先看前一句在做什麼，再看這一句在做什麼，兩者的關係決定填哪一個。前一句 Road running is often a community-wide event that highlights or raises money for an issue or project.（路跑常是全社區的活動，用來凸顯某個議題或為某個計畫募款）講的是通則；這一句 Race for the Cure is held throughout the U.S. to raise breast cancer awareness. 端出來的是一個有名有姓的具體活動。從通則走到具體個案，就是 For example。順便把兩組容易混淆的分清楚：for example 與 for instance 是舉一個具體的例子；that is 與 in other words 是把同一件事換句話說，後面接的還是同一件事。（學測 89 年第 27 題與第 29 題把這兩組擺在同一篇裡考，可以對照著看。）同一篇的第 17 題其實也在做「先講通則再舉例」的事：because it {17} all ages and abilities 是通則，下一句的 first time amateurs 與 running club members 就是例子，只是那裡沒有用轉折詞標出來。有標記的與沒標記的都要讀得出來。【誘答選項】Above all（最重要的是）用來在好幾件事情裡挑出最重要的一件，但前文沒有列出一串事情讓你挑。As it appears（就目前看來）帶著「只是表面如此、未必確定」的口吻，而 Race for the Cure 是實際在美國各地舉辦的活動，不是看起來如此。To some extent（在某種程度上）是打折扣、退一步的說法，這一句沒有在讓步，是在正面舉證支持前一句。【常考字詞與句型】for example（舉例來說）、in other words（換句話說）、above all（最重要的是）、to some extent（在某種程度上）、raise money for（為……募款）、raise awareness（喚起大眾對某事的重視）。

sentence: In certain situations such as in crowded subway cars or elevators, it is not always possible for people to keep their __13__ distance from others.
explanation: 空格夾在所有格 their 與名詞 distance 之間，須填形容詞，preferred 是過去分詞轉品當形容詞「偏好的」：在擁擠的車廂或電梯裡，人們不見得能與他人保持自己偏好的距離；prefer、preferring、being preferred 都不合。
fullPassage: Have you been irritated by someone standing too close in line, talking too loud or making eye contact for too long? Or, they may have __11__ you with the loud music from their earphones, or by taking up more than one seat on a crowded subway car. You feel unhappy because your personal space has been violated. According to scientists, personal space involves certain invisible forces imposed on you through all the __12__. For example, people may feel their space is being invaded when they experience an unwelcome sound, smell, or stare. In certain situations such as in crowded subway cars or elevators, it is not always possible for people to keep their __13__ distance from others. They learn coping strategies to deal with their discomfort. For instance, people often avoid eye contact with someone standing __14__ them, or they pretend that these people are lifeless objects in their personal space. Given the opportunity, they may __15__ to a corner, putting distance between themselves and strangers. Or, they may sit or stand equidistant from one another like birds on a wire.
note: 【你可能會這樣想】prefer 這個動詞你很熟（prefer A to B），但很少把 preferred 當成一個形容詞記住：「偏好的、首選的」。看到四個選項都由同一個字變化而來，容易覺得要靠語意分，其實這一題靠位置就能定案。【怎麼判斷】先看空格卡在哪裡。their ___ distance——前面是所有格 their，後面是名詞 distance，這個位置要放修飾 distance 的字，在這一題就是形容詞。四個選項都是 prefer 變出來的，所以這一格考的是哪一種形式能當形容詞。先把它還原成關係子句看看：the distance which is preferred by them，他們所偏好的距離。既然過去分詞自己就能當形容詞，這一串就可以直接說成 their preferred distance，跟 our preferred way of living 是一樣的道理。其餘三個用同一個方法還原就過不了關，逐一說明見下一段。這種「過去分詞當形容詞」的例子很常見：a broken window（破掉的窗戶）、fried rice（炒飯）。【誘答選項】preferring 是現在分詞，還原成 the distance which is preferring，語意不通。being preferred 還原成 the distance being preferred，可見 being preferred 只能放在 distance 後面，放不到 their 跟 distance 中間。prefer 是原形動詞，動詞不能當形容詞。【常考字詞與句型】preferred distance／method（偏好的距離／首選方法）、prefer A to B（喜歡 A 勝過 B）、prefer to V（寧可）、required documents（必備文件）、reserved seats（預留座位）、personal space（個人空間）。

readMore.label: 延伸閱讀：-ed 形當形容詞（their preferred distance）
readMore.hint: 重點：所有格 their 與名詞 distance 中間是形容詞的位置；分詞當形容詞時，-ing 形多表主動、-ed 形多表被動——距離是「被偏好的」，所以用 preferred。prefer 是動詞原形，接不上；preferring 是主動，讀起來變成 distance 去偏好別人，語意不通；being preferred 是分詞片語，不放在這個位置。

sentence: His code-breaking turned the tide of World War II and helped save two million lives. Nevertheless, __17__ people have even heard his name.
explanation: 【字彙／轉折】前句盛讚其貢獻重大，後句以 Nevertheless（然而）轉折，說明「卻鮮少人聽過他的名字」，故用 few（很少）。many／some 語意相反；any 通常用於否定句或疑問句，不符此處肯定句語境。
fullPassage: Alan Turing was one of the leading scientific geniuses of the 20th century. Many scholars consider him the father of modern computer science. He was also the man who cracked the __16__ uncrackable Enigma code used by Nazi Germany. His code-breaking turned the tide of World War II and helped save two million lives. Nevertheless, __17__ people have even heard his name. Turing displayed signs of high intelligence in math and science at a young age. By the time he was 23, he had already come up with the idea of what __18__ the modern computer—the Turing machine. Today, Turing machines are still used in theoretical computation. He also proposed the now famous Turing test, used to determine whether a computer exhibits intelligent behavior equivalent to that of a human. The postwar era, however, was a disaster for Turing. He was gay, which was then a crime in Britain. __19__ being hailed as one of the crucial figures in defeating the Nazis, Turing was convicted of "gross indecency." This __20__ drove him to commit suicide in 1954, at the age of 41. Nearly 60 years after his death, Queen Elizabeth II granted Turing a formal pardon for his conviction, upon an online petition signed by prominent scientists and technology leaders around the world.
contextNote: Nevertheless 轉折前一句「他的破譯拯救了兩百萬人」
note: 【你可能會這樣想】看到 people have even heard his name，很容易先讀成「有人聽過他的名字」，覺得 some 或 many 都說得通；even（甚至）看起來像在加強語氣，更會把你往肯定的方向推。【怎麼判斷】四個選項都是數量詞，除了 any 之外，其餘三個文法上都放得進去，可見這一格考的是「多還是少」，而方向由句首的 Nevertheless 決定——轉折詞是很好認的邏輯勾環，看到 Nevertheless、however、therefore、for example 這一類字，先回頭看前一句，方向就出來了。Nevertheless（然而、儘管如此）要求這一句與前一句相反：前一句剛說他的解碼扭轉了二戰局勢、幫忙救了兩百萬條性命，這一句就只能往下掉——這麼大的貢獻，卻幾乎沒有人聽過他的名字。few（幾乎沒有）本身帶著否定意味，正好配合這個轉折。另一個線索是 even：have even heard his name（連他的名字都聽過）講的是最低限度的一件事，配上 few 才讀得通，連最起碼的「聽過名字」都很少有人做到。順便把 few 與 a few 分清楚：few 是幾乎沒有，a few 是有一些；little 與 a little 同理，差一個冠詞就差很多。這一格的鑑別度高達 59，分開的正是「有沒有回頭讀前一句」——只讀空格所在的這一句，many、some、few 其實都塞得進去。另外一提：這一篇選文後來被 107 學年度起適用的指考參考試卷沿用，在那份卷子上編為第 17 題，兩邊是同一題，不是網站重複。【誘答選項】many（許多）與 some（一些）方向都偏肯定，若真的很多人聽過，前一句的貢獻與這一句就沒有落差，Nevertheless 也就沒有存在的理由。any 不能這樣用：它的位置在否定句、疑問句與條件句裡（I don't have any money.、Do you have any questions?），或表示「任何一個」的泛指（Any child can learn it.），單獨擺在一個陳述事實的肯定句裡當主詞的修飾語並不成立。【常考字詞與句型】few 加可數複數名詞（幾乎沒有）、a few 加可數複數名詞（有一些）、little 加不可數名詞（幾乎沒有）、a little 加不可數名詞（有一點）、nevertheless（然而、儘管如此）、even（連……也，用來加強最低限度的說法）。

sentence: By the time he was 23, he had already come up with the idea of what __18__ the modern computer—the Turing machine.
explanation: 【過去的未來】would become 表示「未來將成為」，站在過去時間點描述後來成真的未來事件（此構想後來發展成現代電腦）。should become（應該成為）、could have become（本可能成為，暗示未實現）、had become（過去完成式，時序矛盾）都不合文意。
fullPassage: Alan Turing was one of the leading scientific geniuses of the 20th century. Many scholars consider him the father of modern computer science. He was also the man who cracked the __16__ uncrackable Enigma code used by Nazi Germany. His code-breaking turned the tide of World War II and helped save two million lives. Nevertheless, __17__ people have even heard his name. Turing displayed signs of high intelligence in math and science at a young age. By the time he was 23, he had already come up with the idea of what __18__ the modern computer—the Turing machine. Today, Turing machines are still used in theoretical computation. He also proposed the now famous Turing test, used to determine whether a computer exhibits intelligent behavior equivalent to that of a human. The postwar era, however, was a disaster for Turing. He was gay, which was then a crime in Britain. __19__ being hailed as one of the crucial figures in defeating the Nazis, Turing was convicted of "gross indecency." This __20__ drove him to commit suicide in 1954, at the age of 41. note: 【你可能會這樣想】空格前一個子句剛用過 had already come up with（過去完成式），對稱的慣性會讓你想再選一次同樣的形態，had become 於是讀起來特別順；句首的 By the time he was 23 又是過去完成式的典型訊號，更加深了這個念頭。答對率只有五成一。【怎麼判斷】四個選項是同一個動詞 become 配上四種不同的助動詞，但它們問的不是同一件事：would 問的是時間方向，should 問的是語氣，could have 問的是和事實相不相符，had 問的是先後順序。一格要同時判四樣，所以動手之前先把句子的結構定下來，再一項一項刷。先看 what 在子句裡站哪個位置：the idea of what ______ the modern computer，what 是複合關係代名詞（等於 the thing that），它自己就是這個子句的主詞，所以空格填的必定是這個子句的動詞。接著把時間軸排出來：圖靈 23 歲那年（過去）想出了一個構想，那個構想是後來才發展成現代電腦的。站在過去往後看，用的是過去的未來，形態就是 would 加原形。掛鉤是間接引述 He said he would come.（他說他會來）：說的動作在過去，來的動作在那之後。填 would become，讀成「後來會成為現代電腦的那個東西」，時間軸才對得上。這一題的鑑別度只有 23，連高分群考生也在這裡失手，原因就在前一個子句的 had already come up with：對過去完成式越敏感的人，越容易把它當成整句的基準形態照抄一次。但那個過去完成式說的是「想出構想」比 23 歲更早，方向往前；空格這一格要往後看，方向相反，不能照抄。【誘答選項】had become 方向剛好相反，它表示「在 23 歲之前就已經是現代電腦」，但現代電腦是後來的事，時間顛倒了。should become 的 should 帶著建議或義務的口吻，這一句只是在敘述後來發生的事，沒有人在建議什麼。could have become 是「本來有可能成為，但實際上沒有」，與事實不符——同一段後面還寫著 Today, Turing machines are still used in theoretical computation.【常考字詞與句型】would 加原形（站在過去看未來，後來會……）、come up with（想出、提出）、by the time 加子句（到……的時候）、what 等於 the thing that（複合關係代名詞）、could have 加過去分詞（本來有可能……但沒有）、be used in（用於……）。

sentence: For instance, people often avoid eye contact with someone standing __14__ them, or they pretend that these people are lifeless objects in their personal space.
explanation: 【字彙】close to 表示「靠近」，符合「與站在附近的人避免眼神接觸」的文意。long before（很久以前）、aside from（除了…之外）、soon after（不久之後）都與空間鄰近的語境不符。
fullPassage: Have you been irritated by someone standing too close in line, talking too loud or making eye contact for too long?
